xc_files.plain_code:
; Right-hand 300px multifunction display. No flight tuning or PID calls.
; Command telemetry is copied by a read-only, 10Hz observer in flight.main.xc.
var $sqx_rx45_lcd = screen("pilot-screen", 1)
var $sqx_rx45_bg = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $sqx_ui49e_scroll_top = 0
var $sqx_ui49e_edit_center = 0
var $sqx_ui31_edit_solar = 24
var $sqx_ui31_edit_enabled = 1
var $sqx_ui31_edit_frequency = "8844"
var $sqx_sol_edit_frequency = "4488"
var $sqx_ui31_keypad = 0
var $sqx_ui31_digits = ""
var $sqx_ui32_editor = 0
array $sqx_scan31_edits : number
; BROADCAST31 BEGIN editor state
var $sqx_bc31_edit = "4545"
var $sqx_bc31_edit_name = "Badger Smart Quad"
var $sqx_bc31_buffer = ""
var $sqx_bc31_shift = 0
var $sqx_bc31_cursor = 0
; BROADCAST31 END editor state
var $sqx_ui31_edit_timezone = -5
var $sqx_ui31_edit_new_york = 1
var $sqx_ui31_edit_format = 0
var $sqx_rx45_mode = 0
var $sqx_rx45_selected = 0
var $sqx_rx45_coarse = 0
var $sqx_rx45_power = -1
var $sqx_rx45_ready = 0
var $sqx_rx45_key = ""
var $sqx_rx45_ink = color(8, 14, 22)
var $sqx_rx45_panel = color(30, 42, 54)
var $sqx_rx45_hover_since = 0
var $sqx_rx45_hover_pitch = 0
var $sqx_rx45_hover_rpm = 0
var $sqx_rx45_hover_alt = 0
; Unapplied AP drafts never feed flight control; APPLY still commits one selected row.
storage array $sqx_ui33_drafts : number
storage array $sqx_ui33_dirty : number

function @sqx_scan31_recall_all()
	$sqx_scan31_edits.clear()
	repeat 5 ($scan_slot)
		$sqx_scan31_edits.append(@sqx_scan31_get($scan_slot))

function @sqx_scan31_adjust($scan_direction : number)
	var $scan_slot = $sqx_ui46_settings_selected - 12
	var $scan_step = 1
	if $sqx_rx45_coarse and (($scan_slot == 2) or ($scan_slot == 4))
		$scan_step = 10
	elseif $sqx_rx45_coarse and ($scan_slot == 1)
		$scan_step = 5
	$sqx_scan31_edits.$scan_slot = clamp($sqx_scan31_edits.$scan_slot + $scan_direction * $scan_step, @sqx_scan31_min($scan_slot), @sqx_scan31_max($scan_slot))
	$sqx_ui46_notice = "EDIT ONLY - PRESS APPLY"

; Telemetry globals/functions are defined before flight.main.xc.

; All text is centred using font metrics, never native centre alignment.
function @sqx_rx45_text($sqx_rx45_tx : number, $sqx_rx45_ty : number, $sqx_rx45_ts : number, $sqx_rx45_tc : number, $sqx_rx45_tt : text)
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.text_size($sqx_rx45_ts)
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.write($sqx_rx45_tx - size($sqx_rx45_tt) * $sqx_rx45_lcd.char_w / 2, $sqx_rx45_ty - $sqx_rx45_lcd.char_h / 2, $sqx_rx45_tc, $sqx_rx45_tt)

function @sqx_rx45_button($sqx_rx45_bx : number, $sqx_rx45_by : number, $sqx_rx45_bw : number, $sqx_rx45_bh : number, $sqx_rx45_bt : text, $sqx_rx45_on : number)
	var $sqx_rx45_bc = white
	if $sqx_rx45_on
		$sqx_rx45_bc = cyan
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.draw_rect($sqx_rx45_bx, $sqx_rx45_by, $sqx_rx45_bx + $sqx_rx45_bw, $sqx_rx45_by + $sqx_rx45_bh, $sqx_rx45_bc, $sqx_rx45_panel)
	@sqx_rx45_text($sqx_rx45_bx + $sqx_rx45_bw / 2, $sqx_rx45_by + $sqx_rx45_bh / 2, 0.85, $sqx_rx45_bc, $sqx_rx45_bt)

function @sqx_rx45_dial_bg($sqx_rx45_dx : number, $sqx_rx45_dy : number)
	repeat 36 ($sqx_rx45_arc)
		var $sqx_rx45_aa = pi * (0.75 + $sqx_rx45_arc / 24)
		var $sqx_rx45_ab = pi * (0.75 + ($sqx_rx45_arc + 1) / 24)
		$sqx_rx45_bg.draw_triangle($sqx_rx45_dx, $sqx_rx45_dy, $sqx_rx45_dx + cos($sqx_rx45_aa) * 26, $sqx_rx45_dy + sin($sqx_rx45_aa) * 26, $sqx_rx45_dx + cos($sqx_rx45_ab) * 26, $sqx_rx45_dy + sin($sqx_rx45_ab) * 26, $sqx_rx45_panel, $sqx_rx45_panel)
		$sqx_rx45_bg.draw_line($sqx_rx45_dx + cos($sqx_rx45_aa) * 26, $sqx_rx45_dy + sin($sqx_rx45_aa) * 26, $sqx_rx45_dx + cos($sqx_rx45_ab) * 26, $sqx_rx45_dy + sin($sqx_rx45_ab) * 26, white)
	repeat 7 ($sqx_rx45_tick)
		var $sqx_rx45_ta = pi * (0.75 + $sqx_rx45_tick / 4)
		$sqx_rx45_bg.draw_line($sqx_rx45_dx + cos($sqx_rx45_ta) * 22, $sqx_rx45_dy + sin($sqx_rx45_ta) * 22, $sqx_rx45_dx + cos($sqx_rx45_ta) * 26, $sqx_rx45_dy + sin($sqx_rx45_ta) * 26, white)

function @sqx_rx45_prepare()
	$sqx_rx45_bg.blank($sqx_rx45_ink)
	repeat 4 ($sqx_rx45_column)
		@sqx_rx45_dial_bg(37.5 + $sqx_rx45_column * 75, 92)
		@sqx_rx45_dial_bg(37.5 + $sqx_rx45_column * 75, 203)
	$sqx_rx45_ready = 1

function @sqx_rx45_pip($sqx_rx45_px : number, $sqx_rx45_py : number, $sqx_rx45_pv : number, $sqx_rx45_pc : number)
	var $sqx_rx45_pa = pi * (0.75 + clamp($sqx_rx45_pv, 0, 1) * 1.5)
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.draw_line($sqx_rx45_px + cos($sqx_rx45_pa) * 28, $sqx_rx45_py + sin($sqx_rx45_pa) * 28, $sqx_rx45_px + cos($sqx_rx45_pa) * 33, $sqx_rx45_py + sin($sqx_rx45_pa) * 33, $sqx_rx45_pc)

function @sqx_rx45_gauges($sqx_rx45_gx : number, $sqx_rx45_name : text, $sqx_rx45_alias : text, $sqx_rx45_demand : number, $sqx_rx45_pitch : number)
	var $sqx_rx45_rpm = abs(input_number($sqx_rx45_alias, 0)) * 60
	var $sqx_rx45_thrust = input_number($sqx_rx45_alias, 1)
	@sqx_rx45_text($sqx_rx45_gx, 42, 1.3, cyan, $sqx_rx45_name)
	@sqx_rx45_text($sqx_rx45_gx, 59, 1.35, white, text("{0}", $sqx_rx45_rpm))
	var $sqx_rx45_ra = pi * (0.75 + clamp($sqx_rx45_rpm / 3000, 0, 1) * 1.5)
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.draw_line($sqx_rx45_gx, 92, $sqx_rx45_gx + cos($sqx_rx45_ra) * 23, 92 + sin($sqx_rx45_ra) * 23, white)
	@sqx_rx45_pip($sqx_rx45_gx, 92, $sqx_rx45_low / 3000, orange)
	@sqx_rx45_pip($sqx_rx45_gx, 92, $sqx_rx45_high / 3000, red)
	@sqx_rx45_pip($sqx_rx45_gx, 92, abs($sqx_rx45_demand) / 3000, cyan)
	@sqx_rx45_text($sqx_rx45_gx, 127, 0.8, cyan, text("D {0}", abs($sqx_rx45_demand)))
	var $sqx_rx45_pitch_colour = white
	; Thrust readback decides negative thrust; reverse-spinning rotors are normal.
	if $sqx_rx45_thrust < 0
		$sqx_rx45_pitch_colour = red
	@sqx_rx45_text($sqx_rx45_gx, 168, 1.35, $sqx_rx45_pitch_colour, text("{0.00}", abs($sqx_rx45_pitch)))
	var $sqx_rx45_qa = pi * (0.75 + clamp(abs($sqx_rx45_pitch), 0, 1) * 1.5)
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.draw_line($sqx_rx45_gx, 203, $sqx_rx45_gx + cos($sqx_rx45_qa) * 23, 203 + sin($sqx_rx45_qa) * 23, $sqx_rx45_pitch_colour)
	@sqx_rx45_pip($sqx_rx45_gx, 203, $sqx_rx45_pitch_warn, red)
	if ($sqx_rx45_hover_pitch > 0) and (abs($sqx_rx45_rpm - $sqx_rx45_hover_rpm) < $sqx_rx45_hover_rpm * 0.05) and (abs(input_number("nav", 2) - $sqx_rx45_hover_alt) < 30)
		@sqx_rx45_pip($sqx_rx45_gx, 203, $sqx_rx45_hover_pitch, orange)
	@sqx_rx45_text($sqx_rx45_gx, 239, 0.75, $sqx_rx45_pitch_colour, text("{0.0} KN", $sqx_rx45_thrust / 1000))

function @sqx_rx45_rotors()
	screen_copy($sqx_rx45_bg, $sqx_rx45_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)
	@sqx_rx45_gauges(37.5, "FL", "front-left-prop", $sqx_rx45_rfl, $sqx_rx45_pfl)
	@sqx_rx45_gauges(112.5, "FR", "front-right-prop", $sqx_rx45_rfr, $sqx_rx45_pfr)
	@sqx_rx45_gauges(187.5, "RL", "rear-left-prop", $sqx_rx45_rrl, $sqx_rx45_prl)
	@sqx_rx45_gauges(262.5, "RR", "rear-right-prop", $sqx_rx45_rrr, $sqx_rx45_prr)
	@sqx_rx45_text(46, 265, 0.85, cyan, "Demand")
	@sqx_rx45_text(86, 265, 0.85, gray, "|")
	@sqx_rx45_text(128, 265, 0.85, orange, "900 RPM")
	@sqx_rx45_text(171, 265, 0.85, gray, "|")
	@sqx_rx45_text(237, 265, 0.85, red, "Stall Warning")

; Reuses the rotor display's text/button drawing and cached rotor backgrounds.
; One identical header and hit map on every page, including submenus.
function @sqx_ui46_header()
	; Match the neighbouring NAV/DOCK/ORE strip's exact baseline and bounds.
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.draw_rect(0, 0, 300, 27, $sqx_rx45_ink, $sqx_rx45_ink)
	@sqx_rx45_text(50, 13, 1.2, white, "ROTORS")
	@sqx_rx45_text(150, 13, 1.2, white, "AUTOPILOT")
	@sqx_rx45_text(250, 13, 1.2, white, "SETTINGS")
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.draw_rect($sqx_rx45_mode * 100 + 1, 1, $sqx_rx45_mode * 100 + 99, 25, cyan)

function @sqx_ui47_stored_edits()
	$sqx_bc31_edit = $sqx_bc31_frequency
	$sqx_bc31_edit_name = $sqx_bc31_name
	@sqx_scan31_recall_all()
	$sqx_ui46_edit_alt = $sqx_mynumber20 * $sqx_ui46_feet
	$sqx_ui46_edit_speed = $sqx_mynumber21 * $sqx_ui46_knots
	$sqx_ui46_edit_heading = $sqx_mynumber15
	$sqx_ui46_edit_climb = $sqx_ui46_climb * $sqx_ui46_fpm
	$sqx_ui46_edit_descent = $sqx_ui46_descent * $sqx_ui46_fpm
	$sqx_ui46_edit_cap = $sqx_ui46_speed * $sqx_ui46_knots
	$sqx_ui46_edit_floor = $sqx_ui46_floor * $sqx_ui46_feet
	$sqx_ui46_edit_budget = $sqx_ui46_budget
	$sqx_ui49e_edit_center = $sqx_ui48_center
	$sqx_ui31_edit_solar = $sqx_time31_cycle_hours
	$sqx_ui31_edit_enabled = $sqx_time31_enabled
	$sqx_ui31_edit_frequency = $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency
	$sqx_sol_edit_frequency = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency
	$sqx_ui31_edit_timezone = $timezone
	$sqx_ui31_edit_new_york = $sqx_clock31_new_york
	$sqx_ui31_edit_format = $sqx_clock31_format

function @sqx_ui33_draft($index : number, $edit : number, $stored : number, $save : number) : number
	repeat 4 ($slot)
		if $sqx_ui33_drafts.size < 4
			$sqx_ui33_drafts.append(0)
		if $sqx_ui33_dirty.size < 4
			$sqx_ui33_dirty.append(0)
	if $save
		$sqx_ui33_drafts.$index = $edit
		$sqx_ui33_dirty.$index = abs($edit - $stored) > 0.000001
	if $sqx_ui33_dirty.$index
		return $sqx_ui33_drafts.$index
	return $stored

function @sqx_ui33_ap_drafts($save : number)
	$sqx_ui46_edit_alt = @sqx_ui33_draft(0, $sqx_ui46_edit_alt, $sqx_mynumber20 * $sqx_ui46_feet, $save)
	$sqx_ui46_edit_speed = @sqx_ui33_draft(1, $sqx_ui46_edit_speed, $sqx_mynumber21 * $sqx_ui46_knots, $save)
	$sqx_ui46_edit_heading = @sqx_ui33_draft(2, $sqx_ui46_edit_heading, $sqx_mynumber15, $save)
	$sqx_ui46_edit_climb = @sqx_ui33_draft(3, $sqx_ui46_edit_climb, $sqx_ui46_climb * $sqx_ui46_fpm, $save)

function @sqx_ui46_initialize()
	; Safe even when the LCD runs before the first flight update.
	@sqx_ui47_commands_boot()
	@sqx_time31_boot()
	@sqx_clock31_boot()
	@sqx_scan31_boot()
	@sqx_bc31_boot()
	if !$sqx_ui46_initialized
		$sqx_bc31_edit = $sqx_bc31_frequency
		$sqx_bc31_edit_name = $sqx_bc31_name
		@sqx_scan31_recall_all()
		$sqx_ui46_edit_alt = $sqx_mynumber20 * $sqx_ui46_feet
		$sqx_ui46_edit_speed = $sqx_mynumber21 * $sqx_ui46_knots
		$sqx_ui46_edit_heading = $sqx_mynumber15
		$sqx_ui46_edit_climb = $sqx_ui46_climb * $sqx_ui46_fpm
		$sqx_ui46_edit_descent = $sqx_ui46_descent * $sqx_ui46_fpm
		$sqx_ui46_edit_cap = $sqx_ui46_speed * $sqx_ui46_knots
		$sqx_ui46_edit_floor = $sqx_ui46_floor * $sqx_ui46_feet
		$sqx_ui46_edit_budget = $sqx_ui46_budget
		$sqx_ui49e_edit_center = $sqx_ui48_center
		$sqx_ui31_edit_solar = $sqx_time31_cycle_hours
		$sqx_ui31_edit_enabled = $sqx_time31_enabled
		$sqx_ui31_edit_frequency = $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency
		$sqx_sol_edit_frequency = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency
		$sqx_ui31_edit_timezone = $timezone
		$sqx_ui31_edit_new_york = $sqx_clock31_new_york
		$sqx_ui31_edit_format = $sqx_clock31_format
		$sqx_ui46_initialized = 1
		@sqx_ui33_ap_drafts(0)

function @sqx_ui46_footer($sqx_ui46_apply_label : text)
	@sqx_rx45_button(0, 274, 75, 26, "BACK", 0)
	@sqx_rx45_button(75, 274, 75, 26, $sqx_ui46_apply_label, 0)
	var $sqx_ui46_step = "FINE"
	if $sqx_rx45_coarse
		$sqx_ui46_step = "COARSE"
	@sqx_rx45_button(150, 274, 75, 26, $sqx_ui46_step, $sqx_rx45_coarse)
	var $sqx_ui46_last = "MORE"
	if $sqx_rx45_mode == 2
		$sqx_ui46_last = "UNDO"
	@sqx_rx45_button(225, 274, 75, 26, $sqx_ui46_last, $sqx_ui46_more)

function @sqx_ui46_row($sqx_ui46_row : number, $sqx_ui46_name : text, $sqx_ui46_demand : number, $sqx_ui46_actual : number, $sqx_ui46_stored : number, $sqx_ui46_edit : number, $sqx_ui46_selected : number)
	var $sqx_ui46_y = 57 + $sqx_ui46_row * 48
	@sqx_rx45_button(1, $sqx_ui46_y - 16, 43, 32, $sqx_ui46_name, $sqx_ui46_selected)
	if $sqx_ui46_selected
		$sqx_rx45_lcd.draw_rect(47, $sqx_ui46_y - 16, 252, $sqx_ui46_y + 30, cyan)
	; APUNITS31 BEGIN
	var $unit = "fpm"
	if $sqx_ui46_row == 0
		$unit = "ft"
	elseif $sqx_ui46_row == 1
		$unit = "kts"
	elseif $sqx_ui46_row == 2
		$unit = "°"
	; APUNITS31 END
	@sqx_rx45_text(83, $sqx_ui46_y, 1.05, green, text("{0}{}", $sqx_ui46_demand, $unit))
	@sqx_rx45_text(151, $sqx_ui46_y, 1.05, white, text("{0}{}", $sqx_ui46_actual, $unit))
	@sqx_rx45_text(219, $sqx_ui46_y, 1.05, cyan, text("{0}{}", $sqx_ui46_stored, $unit))
	@sqx_rx45_text(149, $sqx_ui46_y + 19, 0.9, yellow, text("EDIT {0}{}", $sqx_ui46_edit, $unit))

function @sqx_ui46_ap()
	$sqx_rx45_lcd.blank($sqx_rx45_ink)
	if $sqx_ui46_more
		@sqx_rx45_text(150, 52, 1.2, cyan, "FLIGHT ACTIONS")
		@sqx_rx45_text(150, 140, 1, cyan, "TAR / REV")
		@sqx_rx45_text(150, 210, 0.85, gray, "ACTIONS BELOW CENTER LCD")
	else
		@sqx_rx45_text(83, 32, 0.7, green, "DEMAND")
		@sqx_rx45_text(151, 32, 0.7, white, "ACTUAL")
		@sqx_rx45_text(219, 32, 0.7, cyan, "STORED")
		@sqx_ui46_row(0, "ALT", $sqx_rx45_alt * $sqx_ui46_feet, input_number("nav", 2) * $sqx_ui46_feet, $sqx_mynumber20 * $sqx_ui46_feet, $sqx_ui46_edit_alt, $sqx_rx45_selected == 0)
		@sqx_ui46_row(1, "SPD", $sqx_rx45_speed * $sqx_ui46_knots, input_number("nav", 0) * $sqx_ui46_knots, $sqx_mynumber21 * $sqx_ui46_knots, $sqx_ui46_edit_speed, $sqx_rx45_selected == 1)
		@sqx_ui46_row(2, "HDG", $sqx_rx45_head, input_number("nav", 6), $sqx_mynumber15, $sqx_ui46_edit_heading, $sqx_rx45_selected == 2)
		@sqx_ui46_row(3, "CLB", $sqx_rx45_vs_limit * $sqx_ui46_fpm, input_number("nav", 1) * $sqx_ui46_fpm, $sqx_ui46_climb * $sqx_ui46_fpm, $sqx_ui46_edit_climb, $sqx_rx45_selected == 3)
		@sqx_rx45_button(256, 41, 43, 32, "+", 0)
		@sqx_rx45_button(256, 89, 43, 32, "-", 0)
		@sqx_rx45_button(256, 137, 43, 32, "UNDO", 0)
		@sqx_rx45_button(256, 185, 43, 32, "NOW", 0)
		@sqx_rx45_text(150, 238, 0.8, gray, "ALT FT | SPD KT | HDG DEG | CLB FPM")
		@sqx_rx45_text(150, 252, 0.8, gray, "CLB = MAX CLIMB, NOT A V/S MODE")
	if $sqx_ad41_active
		@sqx_rx45_text(150, 264, 0.75, orange, "DOCK OWNS CONTROLS")
	else
		@sqx_rx45_text(150, 264, 0.75, cyan, $sqx_ui46_notice)
	@sqx_ui46_footer("APPLY")

; One scrolling Settings list. Four rows are visible; chrome remains fixed.
function @sqx_ui49e_scroll($sqx_ui49e_delta : number)
	if (!@sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)) or ($sqx_rx45_mode != 2) or $sqx_ui31_keypad or $sqx_ui32_editor
		return
	; UP/DOWN moves the selection, never a value. Follow it only at list edges.
	$sqx_ui46_settings_selected = clamp($sqx_ui46_settings_selected - sign($sqx_ui49e_delta), 0, 18)
	if $sqx_ui46_settings_selected < $sqx_ui49e_scroll_top
		$sqx_ui49e_scroll_top = $sqx_ui46_settings_selected
	elseif $sqx_ui46_settings_selected >= $sqx_ui49e_scroll_top + 4
		$sqx_ui49e_scroll_top = $sqx_ui46_settings_selected - 3
	$sqx_ui49e_scroll_top = clamp($sqx_ui49e_scroll_top, 0, 15)
	$sqx_ui46_battery_page = $sqx_ui46_settings_selected == 4
	$sqx_rx45_key = ""

function @sqx_ui32_title($row : number) : text
	if $row == 0
		return "CLIMB LIMIT"
	elseif $row == 1
		return "DESCENT LIMIT"
	elseif $row == 2
		return "SPEED LIMIT"
	elseif $row == 3
		return "GROUND CLEARANCE"
	elseif $row == 4
		return "BATTERY BUDGET"
	elseif $row == 5
		return "ATTITUDE SCREEN"
	elseif $row == 6
		return "SOLAR CYCLE"
	elseif $row == 7
		return "SOLAR DISPLAY"
	elseif $row == 8
		return "SOLAR FALLBACK RX"
	elseif $row == 10
		return "CLOCK TIMEZONE"
	elseif $row == 12
		return "ORE IMAGE RATE"
	elseif $row == 13
		return "ORE SCAN SPEED"
	elseif $row == 14
		return "ORE RESOLUTION"
	elseif $row == 15
		return "ORE NOTICES"
	elseif $row == 16
		return "ORE RED BRIGHTNESS"
	elseif $row == 17
		return "MAIN BEACON TX"
	elseif $row == 18
		return "MAIN BEACON NAME"
	elseif $row == 9
		return "SOLAR DATA RX"
	return "CLOCK FORMAT"

function @sqx_ui32_value($row : number, $edit : number) : text
	if $row == 9
		if $edit
			return $sqx_sol_edit_frequency
		return $sqx_sol_primary_frequency
	if $row == 8
		if $edit
			return $sqx_ui31_edit_frequency
		return $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency
	if $row == 18
		if $edit
			return $sqx_bc31_edit_name
		return $sqx_bc31_name
	if $row == 17
		if $edit
			return $sqx_bc31_edit
		return $sqx_bc31_frequency
	if $row >= 12
		var $scan_slot = $row - 12
		var $scan_value = @sqx_scan31_get($scan_slot)
		if $edit
			$scan_value = $sqx_scan31_edits.$scan_slot
		if $scan_slot == 0
			return text("{0} HZ", $scan_value)
		elseif $scan_slot == 1
			return text("{0}%", $scan_value)
		elseif $scan_slot == 2
			return text("{0} SAMPLES", $scan_value)
		elseif $scan_slot == 3
			if $scan_value
				return "ON"
			return "OFF"
		return text("{0}x", $scan_value)
	var $value = $sqx_ui46_climb * $sqx_ui46_fpm
	var $unit = " FPM"
	if $edit
		$value = $sqx_ui46_edit_climb
	if $row == 1
		$value = $sqx_ui46_descent * $sqx_ui46_fpm
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui46_edit_descent
	elseif $row == 2
		$value = $sqx_ui46_speed * $sqx_ui46_knots
		$unit = " KT"
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui46_edit_cap
	elseif $row == 3
		$value = $sqx_ui46_floor * $sqx_ui46_feet
		$unit = " FT"
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui46_edit_floor
	elseif $row == 4
		$value = $sqx_ui46_budget
		$unit = " MIN"
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui46_edit_budget
	elseif $row == 5
		$value = $sqx_ui48_center
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui49e_edit_center
		if $value
			return "CENTER"
		return "LEFT"
	elseif $row == 6
		$value = $sqx_time31_cycle_hours
		$unit = " HOURS"
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui31_edit_solar
	elseif $row == 7
		$value = $sqx_time31_enabled
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui31_edit_enabled
		if $value
			return "ON"
		return "OFF"
	elseif $row == 10
		$value = $timezone
		var $preset = $sqx_clock31_new_york
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui31_edit_timezone
			$preset = $sqx_ui31_edit_new_york
		if $preset
			return "NEW_YORK"
		return @sqx_clock31_timezone_text($value)
	elseif $row == 11
		$value = $sqx_clock31_format
		if $edit
			$value = $sqx_ui31_edit_format
		if $value == 12
			return "12H AM/PM"
		elseif $value == 24
			return "24H MILITARY"
		return text("AUTO ({0}H)", @sqx_clock31_format_hours($value))
	return text("{0}{}", $value, $unit)

	if ($sqx_rx45_mode == 2) and ($sqx_ui46_settings_selected >= 12)

		$sqx_ui46_notice = "SOLAR DISPLAY SAVED"
		return

			$sqx_ui46_notice = "SOLAR FALLBACK RX SAVED"
		else
			$sqx_ui46_notice = "ENTER 1-32 CHARACTERS"

		$sqx_ui31_edit_solar = $sqx_time31_cycle_hours
		$sqx_ui46_notice = "SOLAR CYCLE SAVED"

		$sqx_ui48_center = $sqx_ui49e_edit_center
		$sqx_ui46_notice = "LAYOUT SAVED"
		return

	if ($sqx_ui46_channel == 5) or ($sqx_ui46_channel == 11) or ($sqx_ui46_channel == 17)
		return 1
	if $sqx_ui46_channel == 16

xc_files.plain_code:
; NAV arrival planner: transient requests only, no stored mission or PID writes.
; Uses the main beacon's verified mount: X=right, Y=up, Z=backward.
var $sqx_na_ready = 0
var $sqx_na_active = 0
var $sqx_na_valid = 0
var $sqx_na_arrived = 0
var $sqx_na_speed = 0
var $sqx_na_altitude = 0
var $sqx_na_cruise_altitude = 0
var $sqx_na_selected_altitude = 0
var $sqx_na_horizontal = 0
var $sqx_na_beacon_altitude = 0
var $sqx_na_fast_floor = 0
var $sqx_na_receive_after = 0
var $sqx_na_signal_lost = 0

function @sqx_na_speed_limit($na_remaining : number) : number
	; v^2/(2a) + 4v stopping allowance, with conservative a=0.5m/s^2.
	; The four seconds cover the existing speed filter/control response.
	return min(max(sqrt(4 + max($na_remaining, 0)) - 2, 0), max($na_remaining, 0) * 0.2)

function @sqx_na_profile_altitude($na_destination : number, $na_remaining : number, $na_speed : number, $na_descent : number, $na_cruise : number) : number
	; 70% of the selected descent rate leaves capture/rotor-authority margin.
	; Higher altitude, faster travel or a slower descent therefore starts sooner.
	return min($na_cruise, $na_destination + max($na_remaining - 5 * $na_speed, 0) / max($na_speed, 10) * $na_descent * 0.7)

function @sqx_na_update($na_enabled : number, $na_alt : number, $na_agl : number, $na_heading_error : number, $na_ground : number, $na_dt : number)
	$sqx_na_active = $na_enabled
	$sqx_na_valid = 0
	if !$na_enabled
		$sqx_na_ready = 0
		$sqx_na_arrived = 0
		$sqx_na_signal_lost = 0
		return
	var $na_step = clamp($na_dt, 0, 0.2)
	if !$sqx_na_ready
		$sqx_na_altitude = $na_alt
		$sqx_na_speed = max($sqx_pitchs, 0)
		$sqx_na_cruise_altitude = max($na_alt, $sqx_mynumber20)
		$sqx_na_selected_altitude = $sqx_mynumber20
		$sqx_na_arrived = 0
		$sqx_na_signal_lost = 0
		$sqx_na_ready = 1
	if $sqx_na_selected_altitude != $sqx_mynumber20
		$sqx_na_cruise_altitude = $sqx_mynumber20
		$sqx_na_selected_altitude = $sqx_mynumber20
	; A retuned or lost beacon commands a stop/hover, never blind cruise/descent.
	if (!input_number("beacon", 5)) or (time < $sqx_na_receive_after)
		$sqx_na_speed = max($sqx_na_speed - $na_step, 0)
		if !$sqx_na_signal_lost
			$sqx_na_altitude = $na_alt
		$sqx_na_signal_lost = 1
		return
	var $na_distance = input_number("beacon", 1)
	if $na_distance <= 0
		$sqx_na_speed = max($sqx_na_speed - $na_step, 0)
		if !$sqx_na_signal_lost
			$sqx_na_altitude = $na_alt
		$sqx_na_signal_lost = 1
		return
	$sqx_na_valid = 1
	$sqx_na_signal_lost = 0
	var $na_x = input_number("beacon", 2) * $na_distance
	var $na_up = input_number("beacon", 3) * $na_distance
	var $na_forward = -input_number("beacon", 4) * $na_distance
	var $na_bank = input_number("nav", 5) * pi
	var $na_pitch = input_number("nav", 4) * pi
	var $na_right = $na_x * cos($na_bank) - $na_up * sin($na_bank)
	var $na_untilted_up = $na_x * sin($na_bank) + $na_up * cos($na_bank)
	var $na_level_forward = $na_forward * cos($na_pitch) + $na_untilted_up * sin($na_pitch)
	var $na_level_up = $na_untilted_up * cos($na_pitch) - $na_forward * sin($na_pitch)
	$sqx_na_horizontal = sqrt($na_right * $na_right + $na_level_forward * $na_level_forward)
	; Conservative distant estimate; current terrain/water guard stays authoritative.
	; Near the destination the measured vertical vector gives its local elevation.
	$sqx_na_beacon_altitude = max($na_alt + $na_level_up, 0)
	var $na_remaining = max($sqx_na_horizontal - 20, 0)
	if ($sqx_na_horizontal <= 25) and (abs($na_ground) < 0.5)
		$sqx_na_arrived = 1
	var $na_request = min(min(max($sqx_mynumber21, 0), $sqx_ui46_speed), @sqx_na_speed_limit($na_remaining))
	; Brake before large turns, then restore cruise speed as the bearing settles.
	$na_request *= clamp((90 - abs($na_heading_error)) / 60, 0, 1)
	; Do not accelerate through 100 knots until measured clearance is available.
	if ($na_alt - max($na_alt - $na_agl, 0)) < 320
		$na_request = min($na_request, 95 / $sqx_ui46_knots)
	if $sqx_na_arrived
		$na_request = 0
	$sqx_na_speed += clamp($na_request - $sqx_na_speed, -$na_step, 0.8 * $na_step)
	var $na_clearance = $sqx_ui46_floor
	if $sqx_na_fast_floor
		$na_clearance = max($na_clearance, 304.8)
	var $na_destination = $sqx_na_beacon_altitude + $na_clearance
	var $na_cruise = max($sqx_na_cruise_altitude, $na_destination)
	var $na_planning_speed = max(abs($na_ground), max($sqx_na_speed, min(max($sqx_mynumber21, 0), $sqx_ui46_speed)))
	var $na_profile = @sqx_na_profile_altitude($na_destination, $na_remaining, $na_planning_speed, min($sqx_ui46_descent, 20), $na_cruise)
	; Finish descent even if we reached the horizontal stop point while still high.
	; No LAND/DOCK command is issued and the anchor is never deployed by NAV.
	$sqx_na_altitude += clamp($na_profile - $sqx_na_altitude, -min($sqx_ui46_descent, 20) * $na_step, $sqx_ui46_climb * $na_step)

; SQ3.10: one-beacon Solar4488V2 receiver, local geometric horizon predictions.
; No flight ownership. All angles are radians; timestamps use unshifted time.
var $sqx_sol_slot = -1
; -1 needs startup, 0 preferred, 1 legacy, 2 exhausted until cockpit-power cycle.
var $sqx_sol_epoch_seen = -1
storage var $sqx_sol_options : number
storage var $sqx_sol_primary_frequency : text
storage var $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency : text
var $sqx_sol_fallback = ""
var $sqx_sol_primary_tuned = ""
var $sqx_sol_switch_at = 0
var $sqx_sol_wait_until = 0
var $sqx_sol_seen = ""
var $sqx_sol_new_signal = 0
var $sqx_sol_model = 0
var $sqx_sol_valid = 0
var $sqx_sol_identity = ""
var $sqx_sol_last_stamp = 0
var $sqx_sol_status = "WAITING"
var $sqx_sol_hour = 0
var $sqx_sol_decl = 0
var $sqx_sol_rate = 0
var $sqx_sol_drift = 0
var $sqx_sol_phi = 0
var $sqx_sol_horizon = 0
var $sqx_sol_cycle = 0
var $sqx_sol_previous = -1000000000
var $sqx_sol_next = 1000000000
var $sqx_sol_mode = 0
var $sqx_sol_deadline = 0
var $sqx_sol_elapsed = 0
var $sqx_sol_phase = 0
var $sqx_sol_period = 0
var $sqx_sol_solves = 0
var $sqx_sol_line = "WAITING FOR SIGNAL"

function @sqx_sol_boot()
	if !$sqx_sol_options
		$sqx_sol_primary_frequency = "4488"
		; Migrate the saved numeric legacy frequency without changing its storage type.
		$sqx_sol_legacy_frequency = text("{0}", $sqx_time31_frequency)
		$sqx_sol_options = 1

function @sqx_sol_frequency_valid($frequency : text) : number
	return (size($frequency) > 0) and (size($frequency) <= 32)

function @sqx_sol_wrap($angle : number) : number
	return mod(mod($angle, 2 * pi) + 2 * pi, 2 * pi)

function @sqx_sol_number($packet : text, $key : text, $minimum : number, $maximum : number) : number
	if !contains($packet, text(".{}", $key) & "{")
		return 0
	var $value = $packet.$key
	if !isnumeric($value)
		return 0
	var $number = $value:number
	; Range comparisons reject nonfinite values without relying on an invented API.
	return ($number >= $minimum) and ($number <= $maximum)

function @sqx_sol_height($offset : number) : number
	var $decl = $sqx_sol_decl + $sqx_sol_drift * $offset
	return sin($sqx_sol_phi) * sin($decl) + cos($sqx_sol_phi) * cos($decl) * cos($sqx_sol_hour + $sqx_sol_rate * $offset) - sin($sqx_sol_horizon)

function @sqx_sol_derivative($offset : number) : number
	var $decl = $sqx_sol_decl + $sqx_sol_drift * $offset
	var $hour = $sqx_sol_hour + $sqx_sol_rate * $offset
	return sin($sqx_sol_phi) * cos($decl) * $sqx_sol_drift - cos($sqx_sol_phi) * sin($decl) * $sqx_sol_drift * cos($hour) - cos($sqx_sol_phi) * cos($decl) * sin($hour) * $sqx_sol_rate

function @sqx_sol_record($offset : number)
	if abs(@sqx_sol_height($offset)) > 0.0000001
		return
	var $slope = @sqx_sol_derivative($offset)
	; Tangencies are not Sunrise/Sunset crossings.
	if abs($slope) < 0.000000000001
		return
	if ($offset <= 0.01) and ($offset > $sqx_sol_previous)
		$sqx_sol_previous = min($offset, 0)
	if ($offset > 0.01) and ($offset < $sqx_sol_next)
		$sqx_sol_next = $offset
		$sqx_sol_mode = 1
		if $slope > 0
			$sqx_sol_mode = 2

function @sqx_sol_bracket($left : number, $right : number, $stationary : number) : number
	var $fl = @sqx_sol_height($left)
	var $fr = @sqx_sol_height($right)
	if $stationary
		$fl = @sqx_sol_derivative($left)
		$fr = @sqx_sol_derivative($right)
	if $fl * $fr > 0
		return 1000000000
	repeat 28 ($iteration)
		var $middle = ($left + $right) / 2
		var $fm = @sqx_sol_height($middle)
		if $stationary
			$fm = @sqx_sol_derivative($middle)
		if $fl * $fm <= 0
			$right = $middle
		else
			$left = $middle
			$fl = $fm
	return ($left + $right) / 2

function @sqx_sol_segment($left : number, $right : number)
	if @sqx_sol_height($left) * @sqx_sol_height($right) <= 0
		@sqx_sol_record(@sqx_sol_bracket($left, $right, 0))

function @sqx_sol_solve()
	$sqx_sol_solves += 1
	$sqx_sol_previous = -1000000000
	$sqx_sol_next = 1000000000
	$sqx_sol_valid = 0
	$sqx_sol_mode = 0
	$sqx_sol_status = "NO LOCAL EVENT"
	; Xenon numeric equality has a 0.0000001 tolerance: solar drift is
	; smaller than that but significant over hours. Relational <= is exact.
	if abs($sqx_sol_drift) <= 0
		; Constant-declination fast path: no search loop for stable solar models.
		var $denominator = cos($sqx_sol_phi) * cos($sqx_sol_decl)
		if abs($denominator) < 0.000000000001
			return
		var $crossing = (sin($sqx_sol_horizon) - sin($sqx_sol_phi) * sin($sqx_sol_decl)) / $denominator
		if abs($crossing) >= 1
			return
		var $angle = acos($crossing)
		var $direction = sign($sqx_sol_rate)
		var $rise = @sqx_sol_wrap($direction * (-$direction * $angle - $sqx_sol_hour)) / abs($sqx_sol_rate)
		var $set = @sqx_sol_wrap($direction * ($direction * $angle - $sqx_sol_hour)) / abs($sqx_sol_rate)
		if $rise <= 0.01
			@sqx_sol_record(0)
			$rise += $sqx_sol_cycle
		if $set <= 0.01
			@sqx_sol_record(0)
			$set += $sqx_sol_cycle
		@sqx_sol_record($rise)
		@sqx_sol_record($set)
		@sqx_sol_record($rise - $sqx_sol_cycle)
		@sqx_sol_record($set - $sqx_sol_cycle)
	else
		; Bound to one measured cycle each way AND physically valid declinations.
		; Split at derivative extrema so short daylight windows are not skipped.
		var $span = min($sqx_sol_cycle, (pi / 2 - abs($sqx_sol_decl)) / abs($sqx_sol_drift))
		var $step = $span / 96
		repeat 192 ($index)
			var $left = -$span + $index * $step
			var $right = $left + $step
			var $dl = @sqx_sol_derivative($left)
			var $dr = @sqx_sol_derivative($right)
			if $dl * $dr < 0
				var $extreme = @sqx_sol_bracket($left, $right, 1)
				@sqx_sol_segment($left, $extreme)
				@sqx_sol_segment($extreme, $right)
			else
				@sqx_sol_segment($left, $right)
	if ($sqx_sol_previous < -$sqx_sol_cycle - 1) or ($sqx_sol_next > $sqx_sol_cycle + 1)
		return
	$sqx_sol_elapsed = -$sqx_sol_previous
	$sqx_sol_period = $sqx_sol_next - $sqx_sol_previous
	if $sqx_sol_period <= 0
		return
	$sqx_sol_deadline = time + $sqx_sol_next
	$sqx_sol_phase = clamp($sqx_sol_elapsed / $sqx_sol_period, 0, 1) * 0.5
	if $sqx_sol_mode == 2
		$sqx_sol_phase += 0.5
	$sqx_sol_valid = 1
	$sqx_sol_status = "LOCAL"

function @sqx_sol_packet($packet : text) : number
	if ($packet.protocol != "Solar4488V2") or (size($packet.serverid) == 0)
		return 0
	if (!contains($packet, ".celestial{")) or (!contains($packet, ".protocol{")) or (!contains($packet, ".serverid{"))
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "modelvalid", 1, 1)
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "sampletime", 1, 1000000000000)
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "sourcelatitude", -90, 90)
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "sourcelongitude", -180, 180)
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "longitudehouranglesign", -1, 1)
		return 0
	if abs($packet.longitudehouranglesign:number) != 1
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "solarhourangle", -pi, pi)
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "solardeclination", -pi / 2, pi / 2)
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "solarhouranglerate", -0.002, 0.002)
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "solardeclinationrate", -0.0002, 0.0002)
		return 0
	if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "horizonaltitude", 0, 0)
		return 0
	; This version intentionally supports only the supplied geometric h0=0 model.
	var $body = input_text("nav", 13)
	if (size($body) == 0) or (lower($body) != lower($packet.celestial))
		return 0
	var $latitude = input_number("nav", 8)
	var $longitude = input_number("nav", 9)
	if (!(($latitude >= -90) and ($latitude <= 90))) or (!(($longitude >= -180) and ($longitude <= 180)))
		return 0
	var $age = time - $packet.sampletime:number
	; Synchronized Unix clocks: no unmeasured future timestamp allowance.
	if ($age < 0) or ($age > 10)
		return 0
	var $rate = $packet.solarhouranglerate:number
	if (abs($rate) < 2 * pi / 5184000) or (abs($rate) > 2 * pi / 3600)
		return 0
	var $cycle = 2 * pi / abs($rate)
	if contains($packet, ".solarcycleseconds{")
		if !@sqx_sol_number($packet, "solarcycleseconds", 3600, 5184000)
			return 0
		if abs($packet.solarcycleseconds:number - $cycle) > max(5, $cycle * 0.001)
			return 0
	var $drift = $packet.solardeclinationrate:number
	; Bound search complexity and reject a motion model outside tested support.
	if abs($drift) > abs($rate) * 0.1
		return 0
	var $decl = $packet.solardeclination:number + $drift * $age
	if abs($decl) >= pi / 2
		return 0
	var $identity = text("{}|{}", $packet.serverid, $packet.sessionid)
	if $identity != $sqx_sol_identity
		$sqx_sol_last_stamp = 0
		$sqx_sol_identity = $identity
	if $packet.sampletime:number < $sqx_sol_last_stamp
		return 0
	$sqx_sol_last_stamp = $packet.sampletime:number
	$sqx_sol_rate = $rate
	$sqx_sol_cycle = $cycle
	$sqx_sol_drift = $drift
	$sqx_sol_decl = $decl
	$sqx_sol_phi = $latitude * pi / 180
	$sqx_sol_horizon = $packet.horizonaltitude:number
	$sqx_sol_hour = @sqx_sol_wrap($packet.solarhourangle:number + $rate * $age + $packet.longitudehouranglesign:number * ($longitude - $packet.sourcelongitude:number) * pi / 180 + pi) - pi
	@sqx_sol_solve()
	return 1

function @sqx_sol_tune($slot : number)
	$sqx_sol_slot = $slot
	var $frequency = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency
	if $slot == 1
		$frequency = $sqx_sol_fallback
	$sqx_sol_seen = input_text("time-cycle", 0)
	$sqx_sol_new_signal = 0
	$sqx_sol_wait_until = time + 1
	$sqx_sol_switch_at = time + 3
	output_text("time-cycle", 2, $frequency)
	$sqx_sol_model = 0
	$sqx_sol_valid = 0
	$sqx_sol_identity = ""
	$sqx_sol_last_stamp = 0
	$sqx_sol_status = "WAITING"

function @sqx_sol_start()
	$sqx_sol_epoch_seen = $sqx_sol_power_epoch
	$sqx_sol_model = 0
	$sqx_sol_valid = 0
	$sqx_sol_line = ""
	$sqx_sol_slot = -1
	if $sqx_sw49_power and $sqx_time31_enabled
		$sqx_sol_fallback = $sqx_sol_legacy_frequency
		$sqx_sol_primary_tuned = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency
		@sqx_sol_tune(0)

function @sqx_sol_receive($enabled : number, $fallback : text) : number
	$sqx_sol_model = 0
	$sqx_sol_valid = 0
	if !$enabled
		return 0
	; No polling, parsing or frequency writes after both broadcasts are absent.
	if $sqx_sol_slot == 2
		return 0
	if ($sqx_sol_slot < 0) or ($sqx_sol_fallback != $fallback) or ($sqx_sol_primary_tuned != $sqx_sol_primary_frequency)
		$sqx_sol_fallback = $fallback
		$sqx_sol_primary_tuned = $sqx_sol_primary_frequency
		@sqx_sol_tune(0)
		return 0
	if $sqx_sol_slot == 1
		if time < $sqx_sol_wait_until
			return 0
		if input_number("time-cycle", 5)
			$sqx_sol_switch_at = time + 3
		elseif time >= $sqx_sol_switch_at
			$sqx_sol_slot = 2
			$sqx_sol_status = "NO SOLAR SERVER"
		return 0
	if time < $sqx_sol_wait_until
		return 0
	if input_number("time-cycle", 5)
		; Reception is not model validity. A calibrating/malformed/wrong-body
		; broadcast remains selected, but must never render a false local clock.
		$sqx_sol_switch_at = time + 3
		var $packet = input_text("time-cycle", 0)
		if $packet != $sqx_sol_seen
			$sqx_sol_new_signal = 1
		if $sqx_sol_new_signal
			$sqx_sol_model = @sqx_sol_packet($packet)
	if $sqx_sol_model
		return 1
	if time >= $sqx_sol_switch_at
		if $fallback != $sqx_sol_primary_frequency
			@sqx_sol_tune(1)
		else
			$sqx_sol_slot = 2
			$sqx_sol_status = "NO SOLAR SERVER"
	return 0

; Logical replacements for removed dashboard switches. Declare before consumers.
; AP navigation flags must precede the shared switch functions that clear them.
storage var $sqx_ui46_tar : number
storage var $sqx_ui46_nav : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_initialized : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_power : number
; Solar receiver observes cockpit-power edges even between its 1 Hz samples.
var $sqx_sol_power_epoch = 0
storage var $sqx_sw49_rotors : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_park : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_dock : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_stab : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_ap : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_land : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_mine : number
storage var $sqx_sw49_mode : number
var $sqx_sw49_link_until = 0
var $sqx_sw49_notice = ""
var $sqx_sw49_was_tar = 0
var $sqx_sw49_off_context = ""
var $sqx_ap31_disengaged_until = 0
storage var $sqx_sw49_last_ap_off : text
storage var $sqx_sw49_last_ap_off_time : number

function @sqx_sw49_navigation_blocked() : number
	return $sqx_sw49_dock or $sqx_sw49_land or input_number("ship-dock", 0) or input_number("left-anchor", 0)

function @sqx_sw49_boot()
	if !$sqx_sw49_initialized
		$sqx_sw49_power = 1
		$sqx_sw49_rotors = 0
		$sqx_sw49_park = 1
		$sqx_sw49_dock = input_number("ship-dock", 0)
		$sqx_sw49_stab = 0
		$sqx_sw49_ap = 0
		$sqx_sw49_land = input_number("left-anchor", 0)
		$sqx_sw49_mine = 0
		$sqx_sw49_mode = 0
		$sqx_sw49_initialized = 1
	; TAR is now a momentary course action. Ignore a legacy stored latch.
	$sqx_ui46_tar = 0
	$sqx_sw49_was_tar = 0
	if @sqx_sw49_navigation_blocked()
		$sqx_ui46_nav = 0
	if $sqx_sw49_ap
		$sqx_sw49_stab = 1
	else
		; AP-off disarms navigation modes, never the stored heading or target slots.
		$sqx_ui46_tar = 0
		$sqx_ui46_nav = 0
		$sqx_sw49_was_tar = 0

function @sqx_sw49_input($sqx_sw49_alias : text, $sqx_sw49_channel : number) : number
	@sqx_sw49_boot()
	if $sqx_sw49_alias == "main-dash"
		if $sqx_sw49_channel == 2
			return $sqx_sw49_power
		if $sqx_sw49_channel == 3
			return $sqx_sw49_rotors
		if $sqx_sw49_channel == 10
			return $sqx_sw49_park
		if $sqx_sw49_channel == 11
			return $sqx_sw49_dock
		if $sqx_sw49_channel == 18
			return $sqx_sw49_stab
		if $sqx_sw49_channel == 19
			return $sqx_sw49_ap
	return input_number($sqx_sw49_alias, $sqx_sw49_channel)

function @sqx_sw49_record_ap_off($sqx_sw49_off_reason : text)
	$sqx_sw49_last_ap_off = $sqx_sw49_off_reason
	$sqx_sw49_last_ap_off_time = time
	$sqx_ap31_disengaged_until = time + 5
	print(text("AP OFF: {} at {0.00}", $sqx_sw49_off_reason, time))

function @sqx_sw49_output($sqx_sw49_out_alias : text, $sqx_sw49_out_channel : number, $sqx_sw49_value : number)
	; Record the first actual AP-off transition; subsequent shutdown writes do not overwrite it.
	if ($sqx_sw49_out_alias == "main-dash") and (($sqx_sw49_out_channel == 18) or ($sqx_sw49_out_channel == 19)) and (!$sqx_sw49_value) and $sqx_sw49_ap
		if $sqx_sw49_off_context == ""
			$sqx_sw49_off_context = "CONTROL SHUTDOWN / LANDING"
		@sqx_sw49_record_ap_off($sqx_sw49_off_context)
	$sqx_sw49_off_context = ""
	; Automatic shutdown/undock writes change the SAME stored button state.
	if $sqx_sw49_out_alias == "main-dash"
		if $sqx_sw49_out_channel == 2
			if $sqx_sw49_power != ($sqx_sw49_value != 0)
				$sqx_sol_power_epoch += 1
			$sqx_sw49_power = $sqx_sw49_value
		elseif $sqx_sw49_out_channel == 3
			if $sqx_sw49_value and (!$sqx_sw49_rotors) and (!@sqx_wt39_can_start())
				$sqx_sw49_notice = $sqx_wt39_blocked_reason
				return
			$sqx_sw49_rotors = $sqx_sw49_value
		elseif $sqx_sw49_out_channel == 10
			$sqx_sw49_park = $sqx_sw49_value
		elseif $sqx_sw49_out_channel == 11
			$sqx_sw49_dock = $sqx_sw49_value
		elseif $sqx_sw49_out_channel == 18
			$sqx_sw49_stab = $sqx_sw49_value
			if !$sqx_sw49_value
				$sqx_sw49_ap = 0
		elseif $sqx_sw49_out_channel == 19
			$sqx_sw49_ap = $sqx_sw49_value
			if $sqx_sw49_value
				$sqx_sw49_stab = 1
		@sqx_sw49_boot()
		return
	output_number($sqx_sw49_out_alias, $sqx_sw49_out_channel, $sqx_sw49_value)

const $doormax = 0.190000
const $doormin = -0.162000

const $drilleff = "DRILL EFF"
const $minetitle = "MINING"

storage var $_doors_pulse1 : number
var $_doors_pulse1_last_up = 0
storage var $_doors_pulse2 : number
var $_doors_pulse2_last_up = 0

var $sqx_ls47_was_rotors = 0
storage var $sqx_do32_initialized : number
var $sqx_do32_ajar = 0

function @sqx_do32_boot()
	if $sqx_do32_initialized
		return
	; Preserve the physical position on first installation; later boots use storage.
	$_doors_pulse1 = (abs(input_number("left-door", 0)) > 0.001) or (abs(input_number("left-door-top", 0)) > 0.001)
	$_doors_pulse2 = (abs(input_number("right-door", 0)) > 0.001) or (abs(input_number("right-door-top", 0)) > 0.001)
	$sqx_do32_initialized = 1

function @sqx_do32_toggle($side : number)
	@sqx_do32_boot()
	if $side == 0
		$_doors_pulse1 = !$_doors_pulse1
	else
		$_doors_pulse2 = !$_doors_pulse2

function @sqx_do32_sound($priority : number)
	if (!$sqx_do32_ajar) or (!$sqx_sw49_power) or $priority
		return
	$sqx_ls48_alarm_until = time + 0.75
	var $phase = mod(time, 2)
	var $beep = ($phase < 0.15) or (($phase >= 0.3) and ($phase < 0.45))
	output_number("speaker-1", 1, 1000)
	output_number("speaker-2", 1, 1000)
	output_number("speaker-1", 0, 0.35 * $beep * (!$sqx_ls48_mute))
	output_number("speaker-2", 0, 0.35 * $beep * (!$sqx_ls48_mute))

update
	@sqx_do32_boot()
	var $sqx_ls47_rotors = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 3)
	var $sqx_ls47_close_doors = $sqx_ls47_rotors and (!$sqx_ls47_was_rotors)
	$sqx_ls47_was_rotors = $sqx_ls47_rotors
	var $_input_alias_1 = input_number("left-door-butt-1", 0)
	var $_input_alias_2 = input_number("left-door-butt-2", 0)
	var $_doors_pulse1_up_ = ($_input_alias_1 xor $_input_alias_2)
	if $_doors_pulse1_up_ and !$_doors_pulse1_last_up
		$_doors_pulse1!!
	$_doors_pulse1_last_up = $_doors_pulse1_up_
	if $sqx_ls47_close_doors
		$_doors_pulse1 = 0
	output_number("left-door", 0, ($doormin * $_doors_pulse1))
	var $_input_alias_3 = input_number("right-door-button-1", 0)
	var $_input_alias_4 = input_number("right-door-button-2", 0)
	var $_doors_pulse2_up_ = ($_input_alias_3 xor $_input_alias_4)
	if $_doors_pulse2_up_ and !$_doors_pulse2_last_up
		$_doors_pulse2!!
	$_doors_pulse2_last_up = $_doors_pulse2_up_
	if $sqx_ls47_close_doors
		$_doors_pulse2 = 0
	output_number("right-door", 0, ((-$doormin) * $_doors_pulse2))
	output_number("left-door-top", 0, ($doormax * $_doors_pulse1))
	output_number("right-door-top", 0, ((-$doormax) * $_doors_pulse2))
	$sqx_do32_ajar = 0
	if $sqx_ls47_rotors and (!input_number("ship-dock", 0)) and (!input_number("left-anchor", 0)) and (input_number("nav", 3) > 3)
		$sqx_do32_ajar = $_doors_pulse1 or $_doors_pulse2 or (abs(input_number("left-door", 0)) > 0.003) or (abs(input_number("left-door-top", 0)) > 0.003) or (abs(input_number("right-door", 0)) > 0.003) or (abs(input_number("right-door-top", 0)) > 0.003)

xc_files.plain_code:
; REAL-TIME CLOCK BY CHIP PATTON. Gregorian calendar and stored UTC offset.
; V3.1: calendar is cached by day; formatted time changes only once per second.
storage var $timezone : number
storage var $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized : number
storage var $sqx_clock31_new_york : number
; 0 = timezone default, 12/24 = explicit display-format override.
storage var $sqx_clock31_format : number
var $sqx_clock31_year_begin = 0
var $sqx_clock31_year_end = 0
var $sqx_clock31_dst_begin = 0
var $sqx_clock31_dst_end = 0
array $daysInMonth : number
array $monthname : text
var $sqx_v31_clock_second = -1
var $sqx_v31_clock_day = -1
var $sqx_v31_clock_date = ""
var $sqx_v31_clock_time = ""
var $sqx_v31_clock_year = 1970
var $sqx_v31_clock_month = 0
var $sqx_v31_clock_dom = 1
var $sqx_v31_cycle_legacy = "!"
var $sqx_v31_clock_power = -1

function @isLeapYear($year : number) : number
	return (mod($year, 4) == 0 and mod($year, 100) != 0) or mod($year, 400) == 0

function @sqx_clock31_boot()
	if $sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized
		return
	; New_York is the default; manual offsets remain independent of solar time.
	$timezone = -5
	$sqx_clock31_new_york = 1
	$sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized = 1

function @sqx_clock31_timezone_set($offset : number, $new_york : number)
	$timezone = clamp(round($offset * 4), -48, 56) / 4
	$sqx_clock31_new_york = $new_york != 0
	$sqx_clock31_timezone_initialized = 1
	$sqx_v31_clock_second = -1
	$sqx_v31_clock_day = -1

function @sqx_clock31_timezone_text($offset : number) : text
	var $minutes = abs(round($offset * 60))
	var $prefix = "UTC+"
	if $offset < 0
		$prefix = "UTC-"
	return text("{}{00}:{00}", $prefix, floor($minutes / 60), mod($minutes, 60))

function @sqx_clock31_year_day($year : number) : number
	var $prior = $year - 1
	return 365 * ($year - 1970) + floor($prior / 4) - 492 - floor($prior / 100) + 19 + floor($prior / 400) - 4

function @sqx_clock31_new_york_offset() : number
	if (time < $sqx_clock31_year_begin) or (time >= $sqx_clock31_year_end)
		; Rebuild only on a UTC-year change, not every screen update.
		var $year = 1970 + floor(time / 31556952)
		if time < @sqx_clock31_year_day($year) * 86400
			$year -= 1
		elseif time >= @sqx_clock31_year_day($year + 1) * 86400
			$year += 1
		var $first = @sqx_clock31_year_day($year)
		$sqx_clock31_year_begin = $first * 86400
		$sqx_clock31_year_end = @sqx_clock31_year_day($year + 1) * 86400
		var $march = $first + 59 + @isLeapYear($year)
		var $november = $first + 304 + @isLeapYear($year)
		; Current US rules: second March Sunday 07:00 UTC, first November Sunday 06:00 UTC.
		$sqx_clock31_dst_begin = ($march + 7 + mod(7 - mod($march + 4, 7), 7)) * 86400 + 25200
		$sqx_clock31_dst_end = ($november + mod(7 - mod($november + 4, 7), 7)) * 86400 + 21600
	return -5 + ((time >= $sqx_clock31_dst_begin) and (time < $sqx_clock31_dst_end))

function @sqx_clock31_offset() : number
	if $sqx_clock31_new_york
		return @sqx_clock31_new_york_offset()
	return $timezone

function @sqx_clock31_format_hours($choice : number) : number
	if ($choice == 12) or ($choice == 24)
		return $choice
	if $sqx_clock31_new_york
		return 12
	; An offset alone cannot identify a country's clock-format preference.
	return 24

function @sqx_clock31_format_set($choice : number)
	$sqx_clock31_format = 0
	if ($choice == 12) or ($choice == 24)
		$sqx_clock31_format = $choice
	$sqx_v31_clock_second = -1

function @sqx_clock31_hms($hours : number, $minutes : number, $seconds : number) : text
	if @sqx_clock31_format_hours($sqx_clock31_format) == 12
		var $hour = mod($hours, 12)
		if $hour == 0
			$hour = 12
		var $suffix = "AM"
		if $hours >= 12
			$suffix = "PM"
		return text("{0}:{00}:{00} {}", $hour, $minutes, $seconds, $suffix)
	return text("{00}:{00}:{00}", $hours, $minutes, $seconds)

function @sqx_v31_clock_update()
	@sqx_clock31_boot()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power
		if $sqx_v31_clock_power != 0
			output_text("systems-dashboard", 18, "")
			output_text("systems-dashboard", 19, "")
		$sqx_v31_clock_power = 0
		return
	if $sqx_v31_clock_power != 1
		$sqx_v31_clock_second = -1
		$sqx_v31_cycle_legacy = "!"
	$sqx_v31_clock_power = 1
	var $clockSecond = floor(time)
	if $clockSecond == $sqx_v31_clock_second
		return
	$sqx_v31_clock_second = $clockSecond
	var $currentTime = time + @sqx_clock31_offset() * 3600
	var $seconds = floor(mod($currentTime, 60))
	var $totalMinutes = floor($currentTime / 60)
	var $minutes = mod($totalMinutes, 60)
	var $totalHours = floor($totalMinutes / 60)
	var $hours = mod($totalHours, 24)
	var $totalDays = floor($currentTime / 86400)
	if $totalDays != $sqx_v31_clock_day
		$sqx_v31_clock_day = $totalDays
		$sqx_v31_clock_year = 1970
		var $daysRemaining = $totalDays
		repeat 1000 ($i)
			var $yearLength = 365
			if @isLeapYear($sqx_v31_clock_year)
				$yearLength = 366
			if $daysRemaining < $yearLength
				break
			$daysRemaining -= $yearLength
			$sqx_v31_clock_year += 1
		$daysInMonth.1 = 28
		if @isLeapYear($sqx_v31_clock_year)
			$daysInMonth.1 = 29
		$sqx_v31_clock_month = 0
		$sqx_v31_clock_dom = $daysRemaining + 1
		repeat 12 ($i)
			if $sqx_v31_clock_dom <= $daysInMonth.$i
				$sqx_v31_clock_month = $i
				break
			$sqx_v31_clock_dom -= $daysInMonth.$i
		$sqx_v31_clock_date = text("{0} {} '{00}", $sqx_v31_clock_dom, $monthname.$sqx_v31_clock_month, mod($sqx_v31_clock_year, 100))
	$sqx_v31_clock_time = @sqx_clock31_hms($hours, $minutes, $seconds)
	; Keep the two existing small LCDs working until the player removes them.
	output_text("systems-dashboard", 18, text("{} {}", $sqx_v31_clock_date, $sqx_v31_clock_time))
	var $cycle = "SOLAR OFF"
	if $sqx_time31_enabled
		; Do not send the new structured packet to the old small text LCD.
		$cycle = $sqx_sol_line
	if $cycle != $sqx_v31_cycle_legacy
		output_text("systems-dashboard", 19, $cycle)
		$sqx_v31_cycle_legacy = $cycle

update
	@sqx_v31_clock_update()

xc_files.plain_code:
; TOP-RIGHT LCD: heading-up NAV arc, precise DOCK view, shared-scan ORE view.
; No flight/AP/beacon output calls. Clicks only change views or ore-scanner settings.
var $sqx_nd44_lcd = screen("pilot-screen", 2)
var $sqx_nd49c_pointer_cache = virtualscreen(20, 14)
var $sqx_nd48_heading_cache = virtualscreen(360, 360)
var $sqx_nd49b_heading_filled = virtualscreen(360, 360)
var $sqx_nd44_compass_cache = virtualscreen(360, 360)
var $sqx_nd44_nav_cache = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $sqx_nd44_bg = color(8, 14, 22)
var $sqx_nd44_ready = 0
var $sqx_nd44_power = -1
var $sqx_nd44_mode = 0
var $sqx_nd44_range = 2
var $sqx_nd44_key = ""
var $sqx_nd47a_magenta = color(255, 0, 255)

var $sqx_nd48_left = screen("pilot-screen", 0)
var $sqx_nd48_center = screen("pilot-screen", 2)
var $sqx_nd48_position = 0

function @sqx_nd44_text($sqx_nd44_tx : number, $sqx_nd44_ty : number, $sqx_nd44_scale : number, $sqx_nd44_tc : number, $sqx_nd44_label : text)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.text_size($sqx_nd44_scale)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.write($sqx_nd44_tx - size($sqx_nd44_label) * $sqx_nd44_lcd.char_w / 2, $sqx_nd44_ty - $sqx_nd44_lcd.char_h / 2, $sqx_nd44_tc, $sqx_nd44_label)

function @sqx_nd44_prepare()
	$sqx_nd44_compass_cache.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$sqx_nd44_compass_cache.draw_circle(180, 180, 156, white)
	repeat 72 ($sqx_nd44_ci)
		var $sqx_nd44_ca = $sqx_nd44_ci * 5 * pi / 180
		var $sqx_nd44_inner = 151
		if mod($sqx_nd44_ci, 2) == 0
			$sqx_nd44_inner = 147
		$sqx_nd44_compass_cache.draw_line(180 + sin($sqx_nd44_ca) * $sqx_nd44_inner, 180 - cos($sqx_nd44_ca) * $sqx_nd44_inner, 180 + sin($sqx_nd44_ca) * 156, 180 - cos($sqx_nd44_ca) * 156, white)
	$sqx_nd44_nav_cache.blank($sqx_nd44_bg)
	$sqx_nd44_nav_cache.draw_circle(150, 240, 48, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_nav_cache.draw_circle(150, 240, 96, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_nav_cache.draw_circle(150, 240, 144, gray)
	$sqx_nd49c_pointer_cache.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$sqx_nd49c_pointer_cache.draw_triangle(1, 1, 19, 1, 10, 13, yellow, yellow)
	$sqx_nd48_heading_cache.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$sqx_nd48_heading_cache.draw_triangle(169, 19, 169, 37, 181, 37, $sqx_nd47a_magenta)
	$sqx_nd48_heading_cache.draw_triangle(191, 19, 179, 37, 191, 37, $sqx_nd47a_magenta)
	$sqx_nd48_heading_cache.draw_line(169, 37, 191, 37, $sqx_nd47a_magenta)
	; Same-sized cache preserves the native rotation pivot of the compass bug.
	$sqx_nd49b_heading_filled.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$sqx_nd49b_heading_filled.draw_triangle(169, 19, 169, 37, 181, 37, $sqx_nd47a_magenta, $sqx_nd47a_magenta)
	$sqx_nd49b_heading_filled.draw_triangle(191, 19, 179, 37, 191, 37, $sqx_nd47a_magenta, $sqx_nd47a_magenta)
	$sqx_nd49b_heading_filled.draw_line(169, 37, 191, 37, $sqx_nd47a_magenta)
	$sqx_nd44_ready = 1

function @sqx_nd44_chrome()
	; One cached warning banner; no per-frame text or polygon rendering.
	screen_copy($dashboard, $sqx_nd44_lcd, 0, 0, 25, 133, 250, 30)
	; Opaque headers/footers mask the map. Touch tabs never change flight modes.
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_rect(0, 0, 300, 27, $sqx_nd44_bg, $sqx_nd44_bg)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_rect(0, 274, 300, 300, $sqx_nd44_bg, $sqx_nd44_bg)
	@sqx_nd44_text(50, 13, 1.2, white, "NAV")
	@sqx_nd44_text(150, 13, 1.2, white, "DOCK")
	@sqx_nd44_text(250, 13, 1.2, white, "ORE")
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_rect($sqx_nd44_mode * 100 + 1, 1, $sqx_nd44_mode * 100 + 99, 25, cyan)
	if $sqx_nd44_mode < 2
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 287, 1, cyan, text("RANGE {}", @sqx_distance31_fit($sqx_nd44_range * 1852, 28)))
		$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_rect(0, 274, 45, 300, cyan)
		$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_rect(255, 274, 300, 300, cyan)
		@sqx_nd44_text(22, 287, 1.5, white, "-")
		@sqx_nd44_text(278, 287, 1.5, white, "+")
	else
		var $sqx_nd44_state = "START"
		if $scan
			$sqx_nd44_state = "STOP"
		@sqx_nd44_text(32, 287, 1, white, $sqx_nd44_state)
		; Explicit ft/NM for every range selection; never ambiguous "miles".
		@sqx_nd44_text(105, 287, 0.9, cyan, @sqx_distance31($max_distance, 0))
		@sqx_nd44_text(173, 287, 1, red, $ore1)
		@sqx_nd44_text(223, 287, 1, green, $ore2)
		@sqx_nd44_text(273, 287, 1, blue, $ore3)
		$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(65, 274, 65, 300, gray)
		$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(145, 274, 145, 300, gray)

function @sqx_nd47a_heading() : number
	; Match the PFD: actual AP command while engaged, otherwise saved bearing.
	var $sqx_nd47a_bearing = $sqx_mynumber15
	if $sqx_ui46_fd_enabled
		$sqx_nd47a_bearing = $sqx_rx45_head
	; Use the same precision for actual and requested headings.
	return mod(round($sqx_nd47a_bearing * 10) / 10 + 720, 360)

function @sqx_nd47a_guidance($sqx_nd47a_hdg : number)
	var $sqx_nd47a_relative = mod(@sqx_nd47a_heading() - $sqx_nd47a_hdg + 540, 360) - 180
	var $sqx_nd47a_angle = $sqx_nd47a_relative * pi / 180
	var $sqx_nd47a_dx = sin($sqx_nd47a_angle)
	var $sqx_nd47a_dy = -cos($sqx_nd47a_angle)
	var $sqx_nd47a_radius = 144
	; Clip the actual bearing ray to the map, not to the compass edge.
	if abs($sqx_nd47a_dx) > 0.00001
		$sqx_nd47a_radius = min($sqx_nd47a_radius, 144 / abs($sqx_nd47a_dx))
	if $sqx_nd47a_dy > 0.00001
		$sqx_nd47a_radius = min($sqx_nd47a_radius, 20 / $sqx_nd47a_dy)
	; Dashed commanded-heading ray distinguishes it from the target vector.
	repeat 12 ($sqx_nd47a_segment)
		var $sqx_nd47a_r1 = $sqx_nd47a_segment * 12
		var $sqx_nd47a_r2 = min($sqx_nd47a_r1 + 8, $sqx_nd47a_radius)
		if $sqx_nd47a_r1 < $sqx_nd47a_radius
			$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(150 + $sqx_nd47a_dx * $sqx_nd47a_r1, 240 + $sqx_nd47a_dy * $sqx_nd47a_r1, 150 + $sqx_nd47a_dx * $sqx_nd47a_r2, 240 + $sqx_nd47a_dy * $sqx_nd47a_r2, $sqx_nd47a_magenta)
	; Off-arc bugs park at the correct edge; the ray retains the real bearing.
	var $sqx_nd49b_bug_source = $sqx_nd48_heading_cache
	if @sqx_ui49b_ap_controlling()
		$sqx_nd49b_bug_source = $sqx_nd49b_heading_filled
	screen_copy($sqx_nd49b_bug_source, $sqx_nd44_lcd, 0, 0, -30, 60, 360, 360, -1, clamp($sqx_nd47a_relative, -70, 70), 1)

function @sqx_nd44_nav_frame($sqx_nd44_hdg : number, $sqx_nd44_track : number, $sqx_nd44_gs : number, $sqx_nd44_signal : number, $sqx_nd44_dist : number, $sqx_nd44_rel : number, $sqx_nd44_msg : text)
	screen_copy($sqx_nd44_nav_cache, $sqx_nd44_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)
	screen_copy($sqx_nd44_compass_cache, $sqx_nd44_lcd, 0, 0, -30, 60, 360, 360, -1, -$sqx_nd44_hdg, 1)
	; Only the visible labels are drawn upright; the tick ring itself is cached.
	repeat 13 ($sqx_nd44_li)
		var $sqx_nd44_lmark = floor($sqx_nd44_hdg / 30) * 30 + ($sqx_nd44_li - 6) * 30
		var $sqx_nd44_lrel = $sqx_nd44_lmark - $sqx_nd44_hdg
		if abs($sqx_nd44_lrel) < 70
			var $sqx_nd44_lbearing = mod($sqx_nd44_lmark + 720, 360)
			var $sqx_nd44_llabel = text("{00}", $sqx_nd44_lbearing / 10)
			if $sqx_nd44_lbearing == 0
				$sqx_nd44_llabel = "N"
			elseif $sqx_nd44_lbearing == 90
				$sqx_nd44_llabel = "E"
			elseif $sqx_nd44_lbearing == 180
				$sqx_nd44_llabel = "S"
			elseif $sqx_nd44_lbearing == 270
				$sqx_nd44_llabel = "W"
			@sqx_nd44_text(150 + sin($sqx_nd44_lrel * pi / 180) * 135, 240 - cos($sqx_nd44_lrel * pi / 180) * 135, 1.1, white, $sqx_nd44_llabel)
	; Ground track relative to heading; native course is unreliable when stopped.
	if $sqx_nd44_gs > 1
		var $sqx_nd44_tr = (($sqx_nd44_track - $sqx_nd44_hdg + 540) % 360 - 180) * pi / 180
		$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(150, 240, 150 + sin($sqx_nd44_tr) * 130, 240 - cos($sqx_nd44_tr) * 130, green)
	@sqx_nd44_text(150, 36, 1.6, green, text("HDG {000}", $sqx_nd44_hdg))
	@sqx_nd44_text(46, 36, 1, white, text("GS {0}", $sqx_nd44_gs))
	@sqx_nd44_text(253, 36, 1, cyan, substring($sqx_nd44_msg, 0, 12))
	@sqx_nd44_text(190, 145, 0.7, gray, @sqx_distance31($sqx_nd44_range * 1852 * 2 / 3, 0))
	@sqx_nd44_text(190, 192, 0.7, gray, @sqx_distance31($sqx_nd44_range * 1852 / 3, 0))
	; Raise only the fixed pointer: tip y=90 leaves seven pixels above the M base.
	; The flight indicator's already-correct pointer geometry is unchanged.
	screen_copy($sqx_nd49c_pointer_cache, $sqx_nd44_lcd, 0, 0, 140, 77, 20, 14)
	if $sqx_nd44_signal
		var $sqx_nd47a_target_colour = cyan
		if $sqx_ui46_tar
			$sqx_nd47a_target_colour = $sqx_nd47a_magenta
		var $sqx_nd44_ta = $sqx_nd44_rel * pi / 180
		var $sqx_nd44_radius = min($sqx_nd44_dist / ($sqx_nd44_range * 1852), 1) * 144
		var $sqx_nd44_px = 150 + sin($sqx_nd44_ta) * $sqx_nd44_radius
		var $sqx_nd44_py = 240 - cos($sqx_nd44_ta) * $sqx_nd44_radius
		$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(150, 240, $sqx_nd44_px, min($sqx_nd44_py, 256), $sqx_nd47a_target_colour)
		if $sqx_nd44_py > 256
			@sqx_nd44_text(150, 254, 0.9, orange, "TARGET BEHIND")
		else
			$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_nd44_px, $sqx_nd44_py - 5, $sqx_nd44_px + 5, $sqx_nd44_py, $sqx_nd47a_target_colour)
			$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_nd44_px + 5, $sqx_nd44_py, $sqx_nd44_px, $sqx_nd44_py + 5, $sqx_nd47a_target_colour)
			$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_nd44_px, $sqx_nd44_py + 5, $sqx_nd44_px - 5, $sqx_nd44_py, $sqx_nd47a_target_colour)
			$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_nd44_px - 5, $sqx_nd44_py, $sqx_nd44_px, $sqx_nd44_py - 5, $sqx_nd47a_target_colour)
		@sqx_nd44_text(85, 53, 0.9, cyan, text("DIST {}", @sqx_distance31_fit($sqx_nd44_dist, 23)))
		@sqx_nd44_text(246, 53, 0.9, cyan, text("BRG {000}", mod(round($sqx_nd44_hdg + $sqx_nd44_rel) + 360, 360)))
		if $sqx_nd44_dist > ($sqx_nd44_range * 1852)
			@sqx_nd44_text(150, 67, 0.9, orange, "OFF SCALE")
	else
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 146, 1.4, orange, "NO TARGET SIGNAL")
	@sqx_nd47a_guidance($sqx_nd44_hdg)
	; Fixed own-aircraft symbol.
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(150, 230, 150, 248, white)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(138, 241, 162, 241, white)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(146, 247, 154, 247, white)
	@sqx_nd44_chrome()

function @sqx_nd44_dock_frame($sqx_nd44_signal : number, $sqx_nd44_dist : number, $sqx_nd44_right : number, $sqx_nd44_forward : number, $sqx_nd44_height : number, $sqx_nd44_bearing : number)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.blank($sqx_nd44_bg)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(50, 164, 250, 164, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_line(150, 42, 150, 264, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_circle(150, 164, 50, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_circle(150, 164, 100, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_rect(138, 152, 162, 176, white)
	if $sqx_nd44_signal
		var $sqx_nd44_dp = max(10, $sqx_nd44_range * 10)
		var $sqx_nd44_dpx = 150 + clamp($sqx_nd44_right / $sqx_nd44_dp, -1, 1) * 100
		var $sqx_nd44_dpy = 164 - clamp($sqx_nd44_forward / $sqx_nd44_dp, -1, 1) * 100
		$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_circle($sqx_nd44_dpx, $sqx_nd44_dpy, 5, cyan)
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 36, 1.1, cyan, text("DOCK HDG {000}", $sqx_nd44_bearing))
		var $sqx_distance31_axes = text("R {}  F {}", @sqx_distance31($sqx_nd44_right, 0), @sqx_distance31($sqx_nd44_forward, 0))
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 235, min(0.85, 288 / max(size($sqx_distance31_axes) * 6, 1)), cyan, $sqx_distance31_axes)
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 251, 1, white, text("HEIGHT {}", @sqx_distance31_fit($sqx_nd44_height, 32)))
	else
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 80, 1.3, orange, "NO DOCK SIGNAL")
	@sqx_nd44_chrome()
	; Keep the original close-range map scale; convert only the footer text.
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_rect(46, 274, 254, 300, $sqx_nd44_bg, $sqx_nd44_bg)
	@sqx_nd44_text(150, 287, 1, cyan, text("RANGE +/- {}", @sqx_distance31_fit(max(10, $sqx_nd44_range * 10), 22)))

function @sqx_nd44_ore_frame()
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.blank($sqx_nd44_bg)
	if @sqx_scan31_get(0) == 10
		screen_copy($sqx_nd44_ore_cache, $sqx_nd44_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 27, 300, 246)
	else
		screen_copy($sqx_scan31_image, $sqx_nd44_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 27, 300, 246)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_circle(150, 150, 36, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_circle(150, 150, 72, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_circle(150, 150, 108, gray)
	$sqx_nd44_lcd.draw_triangle(150, 144, 145, 157, 155, 157, white)
	@sqx_ore31_draw($sqx_nd44_lcd)
	if !$scan
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 150, 1.5, orange, "SCANNER OFF")
	elseif $resting
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 36, 1, cyan, "SCAN RESTING")
	else
		@sqx_nd44_text(150, 36, 1, cyan, "LIVE ORE SCAN")
	@sqx_nd44_chrome()

function @sqx_nd44_poweroff()
	if $sqx_nd44_power != 0
		$sqx_nd44_lcd.blank(black)
	$sqx_nd44_power = 0
	$sqx_nd44_key = ""
	$sqx_nd44_capture = 0

function @sqx_nd48_layout()
	if !@sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
		return
	if $sqx_nd48_position == $sqx_ui48_center
		return
	if !$sqx_ui48_center
		$sqx_nd44_lcd = $sqx_nd48_center
	else
		$sqx_nd44_lcd = $sqx_nd48_left
	$sqx_nd48_position = $sqx_ui48_center
	$sqx_nd44_key = ""

function @sqx_nd44_update()
	@sqx_nd48_layout()
	if !@sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
		@sqx_nd44_poweroff()
	else
		if !$sqx_nd44_ready
			@sqx_nd44_prepare()
		$sqx_nd44_capture = ($sqx_nd44_mode == 2)
		var $sqx_nd44_heading = mod(round(input_number("nav", 6) * 10) / 10 + 360, 360)
		var $sqx_nd44_k = ""
		var $sqx_nd44_signal = 0
		var $sqx_nd44_dist = 0
		var $sqx_nd44_rel = 0
		var $sqx_nd44_track = 0
		var $sqx_nd44_gs = 0
		var $sqx_nd44_payload = ""
		var $sqx_nd44_right = 0
		var $sqx_nd44_forward = 0
		var $sqx_nd44_height = 0
		var $sqx_nd44_dock_heading = 0
		if $sqx_nd44_mode == 0
			var $sqx_nd44_receiver = "beacon"
			if @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 11)
				$sqx_nd44_receiver = "docking-beacon"
			$sqx_nd44_signal = input_number($sqx_nd44_receiver, 5)
			if $sqx_nd44_signal
				$sqx_nd44_dist = round(input_number($sqx_nd44_receiver, 1))
				; EXACT bearing sign used by the existing TAR heading selection.
				$sqx_nd44_rel = round(-input_number("nav", 25) * 180 * 2) / 2
				$sqx_nd44_payload = substring(input_text($sqx_nd44_receiver, 0), 0, 12)
			$sqx_nd44_track = mod(round(input_number("nav", 7)) + 360, 360)
			$sqx_nd44_gs = round(input_number("nav", 10) * 1.94384449)
			$sqx_nd44_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_nd44_mode, $sqx_nd44_range, $sqx_nd44_heading, $sqx_nd44_track, $sqx_nd44_gs, $sqx_nd44_signal, $sqx_nd44_dist, $sqx_nd44_rel, $sqx_nd44_payload)
			$sqx_nd44_k = text("{},{},{},{}", $sqx_nd44_k, @sqx_nd47a_heading(), $sqx_ui46_tar, @sqx_ui49b_ap_controlling())
		elseif $sqx_nd44_mode == 1
			$sqx_nd44_signal = input_number("docking-beacon", 5)
			if $sqx_nd44_signal
				$sqx_nd44_dist = input_number("docking-beacon", 1)
				var $sqx_nd44_raw_x = input_number("docking-beacon", 2) * $sqx_nd44_dist
				var $sqx_nd44_raw_y = input_number("docking-beacon", 3) * $sqx_nd44_dist
				var $sqx_nd44_raw_z = input_number("docking-beacon", 4) * $sqx_nd44_dist
				var $sqx_nd44_bank = input_number("nav", 5) * pi
				var $sqx_nd44_pitch = input_number("nav", 4) * pi
				var $sqx_nd44_up = $sqx_nd44_raw_x * sin($sqx_nd44_bank) + $sqx_nd44_raw_z * cos($sqx_nd44_bank)
				; Exact passed AD41 levelling math, READ ONLY.
				$sqx_nd44_right = round(($sqx_nd44_raw_x * cos($sqx_nd44_bank) - $sqx_nd44_raw_z * sin($sqx_nd44_bank)) * 10) / 10
				$sqx_nd44_forward = round(($sqx_nd44_raw_y * cos($sqx_nd44_pitch) + $sqx_nd44_up * sin($sqx_nd44_pitch)) * 10) / 10
				$sqx_nd44_height = round(($sqx_nd44_raw_y * sin($sqx_nd44_pitch) - $sqx_nd44_up * cos($sqx_nd44_pitch)) * 10) / 10
				$sqx_nd44_dock_heading = mod(round(input_number("docking-beacon", 0)) + 360, 360)
			$sqx_nd44_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_nd44_mode, $sqx_nd44_range, $sqx_nd44_signal, $sqx_nd44_right, $sqx_nd44_forward, $sqx_nd44_height, $sqx_nd44_dock_heading)
		else
			@sqx_scan31_publish()
			$sqx_nd44_k = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_nd44_mode, $scan, $resting, $sqx_scan31_published, $max_distance, $ore1, $ore2, $ore3, $scanArc)
			$sqx_nd44_k = text("{},{},{}", $sqx_nd44_k, $sqx_ore31_revision, @sqx_ore31_phase())
		$sqx_nd44_k = text("{},{}", $sqx_nd44_k, $sqx_status_last_drawn)
		if ($sqx_nd44_power != 1) or ($sqx_nd44_k != $sqx_nd44_key)
			if $sqx_nd44_mode == 0
				@sqx_nd44_nav_frame($sqx_nd44_heading, $sqx_nd44_track, $sqx_nd44_gs, $sqx_nd44_signal, $sqx_nd44_dist, $sqx_nd44_rel, $sqx_nd44_payload)
			elseif $sqx_nd44_mode == 1
				@sqx_nd44_dock_frame($sqx_nd44_signal, $sqx_nd44_dist, $sqx_nd44_right, $sqx_nd44_forward, $sqx_nd44_height, $sqx_nd44_dock_heading)
			else
				@sqx_nd44_ore_frame()
			$sqx_nd44_key = $sqx_nd44_k
			$sqx_nd44_power = 1

function @sqx_nd44_next_ore($sqx_nd44_old : text) : text
	; Same installed scanner palette. Only its stored colour selections change.
	var $sqx_nd44_index = 0
	foreach $oreNames ($sqx_nd44_i, $sqx_nd44_name)
		if $sqx_nd44_name == $sqx_nd44_old
			$sqx_nd44_index = mod($sqx_nd44_i + 1, $oreNames.size)
	return $oreNames.$sqx_nd44_index

function @sqx_nd44_choose($sqx_nd44_x : number, $sqx_nd44_y : number)
	if ($sqx_nd44_power == 1) and ($sqx_nd44_x >= 25) and ($sqx_nd44_x < 275) and ($sqx_nd44_y >= 133) and ($sqx_nd44_y < 163)
		if @sqx_w49_acknowledge()
			$sqx_nd44_key = ""
			return
	if ($sqx_nd44_power == 1) and ($sqx_nd44_x >= 0) and ($sqx_nd44_x < 300)
		if ($sqx_nd44_y >= 0) and ($sqx_nd44_y < 27)
			$sqx_nd44_mode = floor($sqx_nd44_x / 100)
			$sqx_nd44_capture = ($sqx_nd44_mode == 2)
			$sqx_nd44_key = ""
		elseif ($sqx_nd44_y >= 274) and ($sqx_nd44_y < 300)
			if $sqx_nd44_mode < 2
				if $sqx_nd44_x < 45
					$sqx_nd44_range = clamp($sqx_nd44_range / 2, 0.5, 64)
				elseif $sqx_nd44_x >= 255
					$sqx_nd44_range = clamp($sqx_nd44_range * 2, 0.5, 64)
			else
				if $sqx_nd44_x < 65
					$scan = !$scan
				elseif $sqx_nd44_x < 145
					if $max_distance == $shortRange
						$max_distance = $mediumRange
					elseif $max_distance == $mediumRange
						$max_distance = $longRange
					elseif $max_distance == $longRange
						$max_distance = $extendedRange
					else
						$max_distance = $shortRange
				elseif $sqx_nd44_x < 195
					$ore1 = @sqx_nd44_next_ore($ore1)
				elseif $sqx_nd44_x < 245
					$ore2 = @sqx_nd44_next_ore($ore2)
				else
					$ore3 = @sqx_nd44_next_ore($ore3)
				@refreshScreen()
				$resting = 0
				if $sqx_nd44_x >= 65
					$sqx_ore31_context = ""
					@sqx_ore31_begin($ore1, $max_distance, $scanArc)
					$sqx_nd44_ore_cache.blank($sqx_v31_background)
					$sqx_nd44_ore_revision += 1
					$sqx_scan31_published = -1
			$sqx_nd44_key = ""

timer frequency 10
	@sqx_nd44_update()

click.$sqx_nd48_left ($sqx_nd44_click_x : number, $sqx_nd44_click_y : number)
	if $sqx_ui48_center
		@sqx_nd44_choose($sqx_nd44_click_x, $sqx_nd44_click_y)

click.$sqx_nd48_center ($sqx_nd44_click_x : number, $sqx_nd44_click_y : number)
	if !$sqx_ui48_center
		@sqx_nd44_choose($sqx_nd44_click_x, $sqx_nd44_click_y)

; Load observer/interlock only. No PID, trim, throttle or in-flight motor outputs.
; Empty hardware mass is from the user's sensor-equipped v3-9 blueprint.
const $sqx_wt39_blueprint_mass = 3457
const $sqx_wt39_green_limit = 4000
const $sqx_wt39_yellow_limit = 8000
const $sqx_wt39_load_limit = 9000
storage var $sqx_wt39_initialized : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_empty_mass : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_valid : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_x : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_y : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_z : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_heading : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_pitch : number
storage var $sqx_wt39_ref_roll : number
var $sqx_wt39_mass = 0
var $sqx_wt39_load = 0
var $sqx_wt39_rocks = 0
var $sqx_wt39_valid = 0
var $sqx_wt39_overload = 0
var $sqx_wt39_next = 0
var $sqx_wt39_x = 0
var $sqx_wt39_y = 0
var $sqx_wt39_z = 0
var $sqx_wt39_candidate_since = 0
var $sqx_wt39_candidate_x = 0
var $sqx_wt39_candidate_y = 0
var $sqx_wt39_candidate_z = 0
var $sqx_wt39_blocked_until = 0
var $sqx_wt39_blocked_reason = ""
var $sqx_wt39_warning_red = 0
var $sqx_wt39_monitor = 0
var $sqx_wt39_page = 0

function @sqx_wt39_boot()
	if !$sqx_wt39_initialized
		$sqx_wt39_empty_mass = $sqx_wt39_blueprint_mass
		$sqx_wt39_initialized = 1
	; Corrupt/invalid baseline must never increase the permitted load.
	if $sqx_wt39_empty_mass != $sqx_wt39_blueprint_mass
		$sqx_wt39_empty_mass = $sqx_wt39_blueprint_mass
		$sqx_wt39_ref_valid = 0

function @sqx_wt39_sample($sqx_wt39_force : number)
	@sqx_wt39_boot()
	if (!$sqx_wt39_force) and (time < $sqx_wt39_next)
		return
	$sqx_wt39_next = time + 0.2
	$sqx_wt39_mass = input_number("physics", 1)
	var $sqx_wt39_cargo = input_text("cargo-container", 0)
	$sqx_wt39_rocks = max($sqx_wt39_cargo.Rock, 0)
	; Channel 0 is active physics, NOT ground contact. Anchored/docked readings
	; remain usable; zero/default readings and implausible mass are not capacity.
	$sqx_wt39_valid = ($sqx_wt39_mass >= ($sqx_wt39_empty_mass - 2)) and ($sqx_wt39_mass < 10000000) and (input_number("physics", 2) > 0) and (input_number("physics", 3) > 0) and (input_number("physics", 4) > 0)
	$sqx_wt39_load = 0
	if $sqx_wt39_valid
		$sqx_wt39_load = max($sqx_wt39_mass - $sqx_wt39_empty_mass, 0)
	; Raw mass decides the boundary: display rounding cannot allow 9000.1kg.
	$sqx_wt39_overload = ($sqx_wt39_valid and ($sqx_wt39_load > $sqx_wt39_load_limit)) or ($sqx_wt39_rocks > $sqx_wt39_load_limit)
	if !$sqx_wt39_valid
		$sqx_wt39_candidate_since = 0
		return
	if $sqx_wt39_page or (!$sqx_wt39_ref_valid)
		$sqx_wt39_x = input_number("physics", 5)
		$sqx_wt39_y = input_number("physics", 6)
		$sqx_wt39_z = input_number("physics", 7)
	; Never learn a loaded/occupied vehicle as empty. Reference requires known
	; dry mass, zero rocks, stationary craft and stopped measured rotors.
	if !$sqx_wt39_ref_valid
		var $sqx_wt39_empty = (abs($sqx_wt39_mass - $sqx_wt39_empty_mass) < 0.5) and ($sqx_wt39_rocks == 0) and (abs(input_number("nav", 1)) < 0.1) and (abs(input_number("nav", 10)) < 0.1) and (abs(input_number("front-left-prop", 0)) < 0.5) and (abs(input_number("front-right-prop", 0)) < 0.5) and (abs(input_number("rear-left-prop", 0)) < 0.5) and (abs(input_number("rear-right-prop", 0)) < 0.5)
		if !$sqx_wt39_empty
			$sqx_wt39_candidate_since = 0
		elseif ($sqx_wt39_candidate_since == 0) or (abs($sqx_wt39_x - $sqx_wt39_candidate_x) > 0.005) or (abs($sqx_wt39_y - $sqx_wt39_candidate_y) > 0.005) or (abs($sqx_wt39_z - $sqx_wt39_candidate_z) > 0.005)
			$sqx_wt39_candidate_since = time
			$sqx_wt39_candidate_x = $sqx_wt39_x
			$sqx_wt39_candidate_y = $sqx_wt39_y
			$sqx_wt39_candidate_z = $sqx_wt39_z
		elseif time >= $sqx_wt39_candidate_since + 2
			$sqx_wt39_ref_x = $sqx_wt39_x
			$sqx_wt39_ref_y = $sqx_wt39_y
			$sqx_wt39_ref_z = $sqx_wt39_z
			$sqx_wt39_ref_heading = input_number("nav", 6)
			$sqx_wt39_ref_pitch = input_number("nav", 4)
			$sqx_wt39_ref_roll = input_number("nav", 5)
			$sqx_wt39_ref_valid = 1

function @sqx_wt39_can_start() : number
	; Fresh synchronous read for EVERY OFF->ON request, never a cached green.
	@sqx_wt39_sample(1)
	if $sqx_wt39_overload
		$sqx_wt39_blocked_reason = "OVERWEIGHT"
	elseif !$sqx_wt39_valid
		$sqx_wt39_blocked_reason = "MASS SENSOR"
	else
		$sqx_wt39_blocked_until = 0
		$sqx_wt39_blocked_reason = ""
		return 1
	$sqx_wt39_blocked_until = time + 5
	return 0

function @sqx_wt39_warning($sqx_wt39_power : number) : text
	$sqx_wt39_warning_red = 0
	$sqx_wt39_monitor = $sqx_wt39_power
	if !$sqx_wt39_power
		return ""
	@sqx_wt39_sample(0)
	if $sqx_wt39_overload
		$sqx_wt39_warning_red = 1
		return "OVERWEIGHT"
	if !$sqx_wt39_valid
		return "MASS SENSOR"
	if time < $sqx_wt39_blocked_until
		$sqx_wt39_warning_red = $sqx_wt39_blocked_reason == "OVERWEIGHT"
		return $sqx_wt39_blocked_reason
	return ""

function @sqx_wt39_same_pose() : number
	; COM axes are only documented as relative to the sensor position. Until
	; the native coordinate frame is verified, compare at the reference attitude.
	var $sqx_wt39_heading_error = mod(input_number("nav", 6) - $sqx_wt39_ref_heading + 540, 360) - 180
	return $sqx_wt39_ref_valid and (abs($sqx_wt39_heading_error) < 1) and (abs(input_number("nav", 4) - $sqx_wt39_ref_pitch) < (1 / 180)) and (abs(input_number("nav", 5) - $sqx_wt39_ref_roll) < (1 / 180))

timer frequency 5
	if $sqx_wt39_monitor
		@sqx_wt39_sample(0)

function @sqx_yc_wrap($sqx_yc_value:number) : number
	if $sqx_yc_value > 180
		return $sqx_yc_value - 360
	if $sqx_yc_value < -180
		return $sqx_yc_value + 360
	return $sqx_yc_value

function @sqx_yc_directed_error($sqx_yc_target:number, $sqx_yc_heading:number, $sqx_yc_direction_value:number) : number
	var $sqx_yc_delta = $sqx_yc_target - $sqx_yc_heading
	if ($sqx_yc_direction_value > 0) and ($sqx_yc_delta < 0)
		$sqx_yc_delta += 360
	if ($sqx_yc_direction_value < 0) and ($sqx_yc_delta > 0)
		$sqx_yc_delta -= 360
	return $sqx_yc_delta

function @sqx_yc_rate_limit($sqx_yc_error_magnitude:number) : number
	if $sqx_yc_error_magnitude > 90
		return 20
	if $sqx_yc_error_magnitude > 60
		return 14
	return 10

function @sqx_ui47_commands_boot()
	@sqx_ui46_boot()
	if !$sqx_hd32_heading_initialized
		$sqx_mynumber15 = $sqx_ui47_boot_heading
		$sqx_mynumber18 = $sqx_mynumber21
		$sqx_mynumber19 = $sqx_mynumber20
		$sqx_flight_counter3 = $sqx_mynumber15
		$sqx_flight_counter3_init = 1
		$sqx_hdg = $sqx_mynumber15
		$APHeadingVar = $sqx_mynumber15
		$sqx_hd32_heading_initialized = 1


update
	; TAKEOFF31 BEGIN capture
	; Observe BEFORE same-frame UNLAND/UNDOCK clears the grounded state.
	if (!$sqx_to31_active) and ((!$sqx_to31_was_ready) or (!$sqx_sw49_power) or (!$sqx_sw49_rotors) or (!$sqx_sw49_ap))
		@sqx_to31_capture(input_number("left-anchor", 0), input_number("ship-dock", 0), input_number("nav", 2), input_number("nav", 3), input_number("nav", 10), input_number("nav", 1), input_number("nav", 6))
	; TAKEOFF31 END capture
	@sqx_sw49_begin()
	@sqx_ui46_boot()

	; === Cockpit lights and primary mode annunciation ===
	var $sqx_main_power_enabled = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
	@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 4, $sqx_main_power_enabled)
	@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 5, (!$sqx_main_power_enabled))
	var $sqx_rotors_enabled = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 3)
	@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 6, $sqx_rotors_enabled)
	@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 7, (!$sqx_rotors_enabled))
	var $sqx_park_mode_button = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 10)
	@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 12, $sqx_park_mode_button)
	@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 13, (!$sqx_park_mode_button))
	var $sqx_dock_connected = input_number("ship-dock", 0)
	@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 14, $sqx_dock_connected)
	var $sqx_blinker1 = round(time / 1) % 2 == 0
	var $sqx_dock_mode_button = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 11)
	if $sqx_dock_connected and (!$sqx_rotors_enabled)
		$sqx_dock_mode_button = 1
		if @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 11) != 1
			@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 11, 1)
	@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 15, (($sqx_blinker1 * ((!$sqx_dock_connected) and $sqx_dock_mode_button)) + ((!((!$sqx_dock_connected) and $sqx_dock_mode_button)) * (!$sqx_dock_mode_button))))
	$sqx_anchor_engaged = input_number("left-anchor", 0)
	var $sqx_stability_enabled = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 18)
	var $sqx_autopilot_enabled = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 19)
	@sqx_ad41_update()
	; Reuse the existing port output with same-frame auto-undock intent.
	if $sqx_ad41_undock_requested
		$sqx_dock_mode_button = 0
	var $sqx_landing_complete = $sqx_anchor_engaged and $sqx_flight_pulse16
	if $sqx_landing_complete
		if !$sqx_landing_controls_released
			@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 18, 0)
			@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 19, 0)
			@sqx_sw49_output("main-dash", 3, 0)
			$sqx_landing_controls_released = 1
	if !$sqx_anchor_engaged
		$sqx_landing_controls_released = 0
	; Resample stored switches after automatic landing/docking shutdown.
	$sqx_rotors_enabled = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 3)
	$sqx_stability_enabled = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 18)
	$sqx_autopilot_enabled = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 19)
	; Physical lock and power availability, not approach-mode buttons.
	$sqx_pid39_available = $sqx_main_power_enabled and $sqx_rotors_enabled and (!$sqx_dock_connected) and (!$sqx_anchor_engaged)
	$sqx_pid39_reset = !$sqx_pid39_available
	$sqx_pid39_engaging = $sqx_pid39_available and (!$sqx_pid39_was_available)
	$sqx_pid39_ap_active = $sqx_pid39_available and $sqx_autopilot_enabled
	$sqx_pid39_ap_changed = $sqx_pid39_ap_active != $sqx_pid39_was_ap
	if $sqx_pid39_reset
		if $sqx_pid39_was_available or (!$sqx_pid39_initialized)
			@sqx_pid39_reset_hidden()
		@sqx_pid39_reset_auxiliary()
	if !$sqx_pid39_ap_active
		; These memories belong only to AP; STAB/RPM remain independent.
		$sqx_va_alt_integral = 0
		$sqx_va_speed_bias = 0
		$sqx_va_speed_limit_since = 0
		$sqx_va_speed_limited = 0
	$sqx_pid39_initialized = 1
	$sqx_pid39_was_available = $sqx_pid39_available
	$sqx_pid39_was_ap = $sqx_pid39_ap_active
	; TAKEOFF31 BEGIN ownership
	@sqx_to31_update($sqx_main_power_enabled and $sqx_rotors_enabled and $sqx_autopilot_enabled and $sqx_stability_enabled, $sqx_sw49_land or $sqx_ad41_active or $sqx_dock_mode_button, $sqx_anchor_engaged, $sqx_dock_connected, input_number("nav", 2))
	; TAKEOFF31 END ownership
	; Attitude PID ownership, sampled AFTER landing/docking switch shutdown.
	$sqx_ah49c_active = $sqx_pid39_available and $sqx_stability_enabled
	$sqx_ah49c_engaging = $sqx_ah49c_active and (!$sqx_ah49c_was_active)
