xc_files.plain_code:
; DISPLAY ONLY. No control outputs; reads passive command telemetry and armed AP memory.
; 50cm HD panel, pilot-screen channel 0: 300 x 300 pixels.
; Native text alignment is reset to TOP_LEFT; centring uses actual font metrics.
var $sqx_pfd44_lcd = screen("pilot-screen", 0)
var $sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache = virtualscreen(48, 11)
var $sqx_pfd48_heading_cache = virtualscreen(44, 18)
var $sqx_pfd47_speed_pips = virtualscreen(4, 2400)
var $sqx_pfd47_alt_pips = virtualscreen(8, 600)
const $sqx_pfd44_w = 300
const $sqx_pfd44_h = 300
const $sqx_pfd44_d = 300
const $sqx_pfd44_atlas_size = 1080
const $sqx_pfd44_cx = 150
const $sqx_pfd44_cy = 150
const $sqx_pfd44_ppd = 3.7
var $sqx_pfd44_atlas = virtualscreen(1080, 1080)
var $sqx_pfd44_bezel = virtualscreen(300, 300)
var $sqx_pfd44_sky = color(20, 101, 164)
var $sqx_pfd44_ground = color(127, 77, 44)
var $sqx_pfd44_ink = color(8, 14, 22)
var $sqx_pfd44_tape = color(38, 47, 57)
var $sqx_pfd44_ready = 0
var $sqx_pfd44_power = -1
var $sqx_pfd44_last_frame = ""
var $sqx_pfd44_mode = 0
var $sqx_pfd44_speed_source = 0
var $sqx_pfd44_path_edge = 0
var $sqx_pfd46_magenta = color(255, 0, 220)

; Centre a label in pixel coordinates WITHOUT text_align(center)'s screen offset.
; Target 0=physical LCD, 1=cached horizon, 2=cached bezel.
var $sqx_pfd48_left = screen("pilot-screen", 0)
var $sqx_pfd48_center = screen("pilot-screen", 2)
var $sqx_pfd48_position = 0
var $sqx_pfd48_frozen = virtualscreen(300, 300)

function @sqx_pfd44_text($sqx_pfd44_destination : number, $sqx_pfd44_tx : number, $sqx_pfd44_ty : number, $sqx_pfd44_scale : number, $sqx_pfd44_colour : number, $sqx_pfd44_label : text)
	if $sqx_pfd44_destination == 0
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.text_size($sqx_pfd44_scale)
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.text_align(top_left)
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.write($sqx_pfd44_tx - size($sqx_pfd44_label) * $sqx_pfd44_lcd.char_w / 2, $sqx_pfd44_ty - $sqx_pfd44_lcd.char_h / 2, $sqx_pfd44_colour, $sqx_pfd44_label)
	elseif $sqx_pfd44_destination == 1
		$sqx_pfd44_atlas.text_size($sqx_pfd44_scale)
		$sqx_pfd44_atlas.text_align(top_left)
		$sqx_pfd44_atlas.write($sqx_pfd44_tx - size($sqx_pfd44_label) * $sqx_pfd44_atlas.char_w / 2, $sqx_pfd44_ty - $sqx_pfd44_atlas.char_h / 2, $sqx_pfd44_colour, $sqx_pfd44_label)
	else
		$sqx_pfd44_bezel.text_size($sqx_pfd44_scale)
		$sqx_pfd44_bezel.text_align(top_left)
		$sqx_pfd44_bezel.write($sqx_pfd44_tx - size($sqx_pfd44_label) * $sqx_pfd44_bezel.char_w / 2, $sqx_pfd44_ty - $sqx_pfd44_bezel.char_h / 2, $sqx_pfd44_colour, $sqx_pfd44_label)

function @sqx_pfd44_prepare()
	; Two large cached colour regions and a fixed pitch ladder, built ONCE.
	$sqx_pfd44_atlas.blank($sqx_pfd44_sky)
	$sqx_pfd44_atlas.draw_rect(0, 540, 1080, 1080, $sqx_pfd44_ground, $sqx_pfd44_ground)
	$sqx_pfd44_atlas.draw_line(0, 540, 1080, 540, white)
	repeat 37 ($sqx_pfd44_pitch_tick)
		var $sqx_pfd44_degrees = ($sqx_pfd44_pitch_tick - 18) * 5
		if $sqx_pfd44_degrees != 0
			var $sqx_pfd44_ly = 540 - $sqx_pfd44_degrees * $sqx_pfd44_ppd
			var $sqx_pfd44_half = 24
			if mod(abs($sqx_pfd44_degrees), 10) == 0
				$sqx_pfd44_half = 40
				@sqx_pfd44_text(1, 482, $sqx_pfd44_ly, 0.8, white, text("{0}", abs($sqx_pfd44_degrees)))
				@sqx_pfd44_text(1, 598, $sqx_pfd44_ly, 0.8, white, text("{0}", abs($sqx_pfd44_degrees)))
			$sqx_pfd44_atlas.draw_line(540 - $sqx_pfd44_half, $sqx_pfd44_ly, 536, $sqx_pfd44_ly, white)
			$sqx_pfd44_atlas.draw_line(544, $sqx_pfd44_ly, 540 + $sqx_pfd44_half, $sqx_pfd44_ly, white)
	; No circular mask: the horizon fills the whole central viewport.
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_rect(0, 0, 53.333333, 300, $sqx_pfd44_tape, $sqx_pfd44_tape)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_rect(236.222222, 0, 286.666667, 300, $sqx_pfd44_tape, $sqx_pfd44_tape)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_rect(53.333333, 0, 236.222222, 27.777778, $sqx_pfd44_ink, $sqx_pfd44_ink)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_rect(53.333333, 260, 236.222222, 300, $sqx_pfd44_ink, $sqx_pfd44_ink)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_line(53.333333, 27.777778, 236.222222, 27.777778, gray)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_line(53.333333, 260, 236.222222, 260, gray)
	@sqx_pfd44_text(2, 261.444444, 10, 0.8, cyan, "LEVEL")
	@sqx_pfd44_text(2, 84.444444, 13.333333, 0.9, white, "FLIGHT")
	@sqx_pfd44_text(2, 145.555556, 13.333333, 0.9, white, "TARGET")
	@sqx_pfd44_text(2, 207.777778, 13.333333, 0.9, white, "DOCK")
	; Fixed aircraft wings/centre box (white); trajectory marker is yellow.
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_line(110, 150, 134.444444, 150, white)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_line(165.555556, 150, 190, 150, white)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_line(134.444444, 150, 134.444444, 155.555556, white)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_line(165.555556, 150, 165.555556, 155.555556, white)
	$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_rect(147.777778, 147.777778, 152.222222, 152.222222, white)
	; Static top bank arc: -60/-45/-30/-20/-10/0/+10/+20/+30/+45/+60.
	repeat 13 ($sqx_pfd44_bank_tick)
		var $sqx_pfd44_bank_deg = ($sqx_pfd44_bank_tick - 6) * 10
		if abs($sqx_pfd44_bank_deg) == 40
			$sqx_pfd44_bank_deg = sign($sqx_pfd44_bank_deg) * 45
		if abs($sqx_pfd44_bank_deg) != 50
			var $sqx_pfd44_ba = $sqx_pfd44_bank_deg * pi / 180
			$sqx_pfd44_bezel.draw_line(150 + sin($sqx_pfd44_ba) * 72, 123.333333 - cos($sqx_pfd44_ba) * 72, 150 + sin($sqx_pfd44_ba) * 79, 123.333333 - cos($sqx_pfd44_ba) * 79, white)
	$sqx_pfd47_speed_pips.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	repeat 401 ($sqx_pfd47_kt)
		var $sqx_pfd47_mark = $sqx_pfd47_kt
		var $sqx_pfd47_colour = white
		if $sqx_pfd47_mark >= 200
			$sqx_pfd47_colour = red
		elseif $sqx_pfd47_mark >= 150
			$sqx_pfd47_colour = orange
		elseif $sqx_pfd47_mark >= 120
			$sqx_pfd47_colour = yellow
		var $sqx_pfd47_py = 2200 - $sqx_pfd47_mark * 5
		$sqx_pfd47_speed_pips.draw_line(0, $sqx_pfd47_py, 3, $sqx_pfd47_py, $sqx_pfd47_colour)
	$sqx_pfd47_alt_pips.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	repeat 45 ($sqx_pfd47_ft)
		var $sqx_pfd47_mark = ($sqx_pfd47_ft - 22) * 25
		if mod($sqx_pfd47_mark + 1000, 100) != 0
			var $sqx_pfd47_width = 3
			if mod($sqx_pfd47_mark + 1000, 100) == 50
				$sqx_pfd47_width = 6
			var $sqx_pfd47_py = 300 - $sqx_pfd47_mark * 0.266667
			$sqx_pfd47_alt_pips.draw_line(0, $sqx_pfd47_py, $sqx_pfd47_width, $sqx_pfd47_py, white)
	$sqx_pfd48_heading_cache.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	; Cache hollow (saved/armed) and filled (AP controlling) variants once.
	$sqx_pfd48_heading_cache.draw_triangle(1, 1, 1, 16, 12, 16, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
	$sqx_pfd48_heading_cache.draw_triangle(21, 1, 10, 16, 21, 16, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
	$sqx_pfd48_heading_cache.draw_line(1, 16, 21, 16, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
	$sqx_pfd48_heading_cache.draw_triangle(23, 1, 23, 16, 34, 16, $sqx_pfd46_magenta, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
	$sqx_pfd48_heading_cache.draw_triangle(43, 1, 32, 16, 43, 16, $sqx_pfd46_magenta, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
	$sqx_pfd48_heading_cache.draw_line(23, 16, 43, 16, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
	; Four static tape tiles: right hollow/filled, left hollow/filled.
	$sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	repeat 4 ($sqx_pfd49c_tile)
		var $sqx_pfd49c_side = 1
		var $sqx_pfd49c_edge = $sqx_pfd49c_tile * 12
		if $sqx_pfd49c_tile >= 2
			$sqx_pfd49c_side = -1
			$sqx_pfd49c_edge += 11
		var $sqx_pfd49c_mid = $sqx_pfd49c_edge + $sqx_pfd49c_side * 5
		var $sqx_pfd49c_far = $sqx_pfd49c_edge + $sqx_pfd49c_side * 11
		if mod($sqx_pfd49c_tile, 2)
			$sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache.draw_triangle($sqx_pfd49c_edge, 5, $sqx_pfd49c_mid, 0, $sqx_pfd49c_mid, 10, $sqx_pfd46_magenta, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
			$sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache.draw_rect(min($sqx_pfd49c_mid, $sqx_pfd49c_far), 0, max($sqx_pfd49c_mid, $sqx_pfd49c_far) + 1, 11, $sqx_pfd46_magenta, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
		$sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache.draw_line($sqx_pfd49c_edge, 5, $sqx_pfd49c_mid, 0, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
		$sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache.draw_line($sqx_pfd49c_mid, 0, $sqx_pfd49c_far, 0, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
		$sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache.draw_line($sqx_pfd49c_far, 0, $sqx_pfd49c_far, 10, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
		$sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache.draw_line($sqx_pfd49c_far, 10, $sqx_pfd49c_mid, 10, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
		$sqx_pfd49c_tape_cache.draw_line($sqx_pfd49c_mid, 10, $sqx_pfd49c_edge, 5, $sqx_pfd46_magenta)
	$sqx_pfd44_ready = 1

function @sqx_pfd46_hatch($sqx_pfd46_x1 : number, $sqx_pfd46_y1 : number, $sqx_pfd46_x2 : number, $sqx_pfd46_y2 : number)
	if $sqx_pfd46_y2 > $sqx_pfd46_y1
		repeat 18 ($sqx_pfd46_hi)
			var $sqx_pfd46_hx = $sqx_pfd46_x1 - 42 + $sqx_pfd46_hi * 6
			var $sqx_pfd46_sx = max($sqx_pfd46_x1, $sqx_pfd46_hx)

			var $sqx_pfd46_ex = min($sqx_pfd46_x2, $sqx_pfd46_hx + $sqx_pfd46_y2 - $sqx_pfd46_y1)
			var $sqx_pfd46_ey = $sqx_pfd46_y2 - max(0, $sqx_pfd46_hx + $sqx_pfd46_y2 - $sqx_pfd46_y1 - $sqx_pfd46_x2)
			if ($sqx_pfd46_ex > $sqx_pfd46_sx) and ($sqx_pfd46_ey > $sqx_pfd46_sy)

function @sqx_pfd46_commands($sqx_pfd46_speed : number, $sqx_pfd46_alt : number, $sqx_pfd46_heading : number, $sqx_pfd46_pitch : number, $sqx_pfd46_roll : number)
	var $sqx_pfd46_selected_speed = $sqx_mynumber21 * $sqx_ui46_knots

function @sqx_pfd44_speed_tape($sqx_pfd44_knots : number)
	var $sqx_pfd46_hover_top = clamp(150 - (10 - $sqx_pfd44_knots) * 5, 24, 287)
	var $sqx_pfd46_hover_bottom = clamp(150 + $sqx_pfd44_knots * 5, 24, 287)
	@sqx_pfd46_hatch(0, $sqx_pfd46_hover_top, 53.333333, $sqx_pfd46_hover_bottom)
	screen_copy($sqx_pfd47_speed_pips, $sqx_pfd44_lcd, 0, 2074 - clamp($sqx_pfd44_knots, 0, 400) * 5, 49.333333, 24, 4, 263)
	var $sqx_pfd44_speed_base = floor($sqx_pfd44_knots / 5) * 5
	repeat 13 ($sqx_pfd44_speed_tick)
		var $sqx_pfd44_speed_mark = $sqx_pfd44_speed_base + ($sqx_pfd44_speed_tick - 6) * 5
		var $sqx_pfd44_speed_y = 150 - ($sqx_pfd44_speed_mark - $sqx_pfd44_knots) * 5
		if ($sqx_pfd44_speed_mark >= 0) and ($sqx_pfd44_speed_mark <= 400) and ($sqx_pfd44_speed_y > 24) and ($sqx_pfd44_speed_y < 287)
			var $sqx_pfd44_speed_colour = white
			if $sqx_pfd44_speed_mark >= 200
				$sqx_pfd44_speed_colour = red
			elseif $sqx_pfd44_speed_mark >= 150
				$sqx_pfd44_speed_colour = orange
			elseif $sqx_pfd44_speed_mark >= 120
				$sqx_pfd44_speed_colour = yellow
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(46.666667, $sqx_pfd44_speed_y, 53.333333, $sqx_pfd44_speed_y, $sqx_pfd44_speed_colour)
			@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 25.555556, $sqx_pfd44_speed_y, 1, $sqx_pfd44_speed_colour, text("{0}", $sqx_pfd44_speed_mark))
	var $sqx_pfd47b_yellow_top = clamp(150 - (150 - $sqx_pfd44_knots) * 5, 24, 287)
	var $sqx_pfd47b_yellow_bottom = clamp(150 - (120 - $sqx_pfd44_knots) * 5, 24, 287)
	if $sqx_pfd47b_yellow_bottom > $sqx_pfd47b_yellow_top
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect(50, $sqx_pfd47b_yellow_top, 53.333333, $sqx_pfd47b_yellow_bottom, yellow, yellow)
	var $sqx_pfd46_orange_top = clamp(150 - (200 - $sqx_pfd44_knots) * 5, 24, 287)
	var $sqx_pfd46_orange_bottom = clamp(150 - (150 - $sqx_pfd44_knots) * 5, 24, 287)
	if $sqx_pfd46_orange_bottom > $sqx_pfd46_orange_top
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect(50, $sqx_pfd46_orange_top, 53.333333, $sqx_pfd46_orange_bottom, orange, orange)
	if $sqx_pfd46_orange_top > 24
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect(50, 24, 53.333333, $sqx_pfd46_orange_top, red, red)
	var $sqx_pfd44_current_speed_colour = white
	if $sqx_pfd44_knots >= 200
		$sqx_pfd44_current_speed_colour = red
	elseif $sqx_pfd44_knots >= 150
		$sqx_pfd44_current_speed_colour = orange
	elseif $sqx_pfd44_knots >= 120
		$sqx_pfd44_current_speed_colour = yellow
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect(0, 136.666667, 52.222222, 158.888889, $sqx_pfd44_current_speed_colour, $sqx_pfd44_ink)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_triangle(52.222222, 136.666667, 58.888889, 147.777778, 52.222222, 158.888889, $sqx_pfd44_current_speed_colour, $sqx_pfd44_ink)
	@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 25.555556, 147.777778, 1.8, $sqx_pfd44_current_speed_colour, text("{0}", $sqx_pfd44_knots))
	; A slim edge stays visible even when the current-value box covers this band.
	@sqx_pfd46_hatch(0, $sqx_pfd46_hover_top, 4, $sqx_pfd46_hover_bottom)

function @sqx_pfd44_alt_tape($sqx_pfd44_feet : number, $sqx_pfd44_surface_feet : number)
	; Brown terrain/water surface band follows the nearest surface, not a fixed ASL.
	var $sqx_pfd44_surface_y = 150 + ($sqx_pfd44_feet - $sqx_pfd44_surface_feet) * 0.266667
	if $sqx_pfd44_surface_y < 300
		; Brown diagonal terrain hatching, not an opaque brown fill.
		var $sqx_pfd44_hatch_top = max(0, $sqx_pfd44_surface_y)
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(236.222222, $sqx_pfd44_hatch_top, 286.666667, $sqx_pfd44_hatch_top, $sqx_pfd44_ground)
		repeat 34 ($sqx_pfd44_hi)
			var $sqx_pfd44_hy = $sqx_pfd44_hatch_top + $sqx_pfd44_hi * 8.888889
			if $sqx_pfd44_hy < 300
				var $sqx_pfd44_hend = min(300, $sqx_pfd44_hy + 50.444444)
				$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(236.222222, $sqx_pfd44_hy, 236.222222 + $sqx_pfd44_hend - $sqx_pfd44_hy, $sqx_pfd44_hend, $sqx_pfd44_ground)
				if $sqx_pfd44_hy == $sqx_pfd44_hatch_top
					repeat 4 ($sqx_pfd44_hj)
						var $sqx_pfd44_hx = 251.111111 + $sqx_pfd44_hj * 8.888889
						$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_pfd44_hx, $sqx_pfd44_hy, 286.666667, min(300, $sqx_pfd44_hy + 286.666667 - $sqx_pfd44_hx), $sqx_pfd44_ground)
	var $sqx_pfd47_phase = $sqx_pfd44_feet - floor($sqx_pfd44_feet / 100) * 100
	screen_copy($sqx_pfd47_alt_pips, $sqx_pfd44_lcd, 0, 174 - $sqx_pfd47_phase * 0.266667, 236.222222, 24, 8, 263)
	var $sqx_pfd44_alt_base = floor($sqx_pfd44_feet / 100) * 100
	repeat 13 ($sqx_pfd44_alt_tick)
		var $sqx_pfd44_alt_mark = $sqx_pfd44_alt_base + ($sqx_pfd44_alt_tick - 6) * 100
		var $sqx_pfd44_alt_y = 150 - ($sqx_pfd44_alt_mark - $sqx_pfd44_feet) * 0.266667
		if ($sqx_pfd44_alt_y > 24) and ($sqx_pfd44_alt_y < 287)
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(236.222222, $sqx_pfd44_alt_y, 247.777778, $sqx_pfd44_alt_y, white)
			@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 262.555556, $sqx_pfd44_alt_y, 0.8, white, text("{0}", $sqx_pfd44_alt_mark))
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect(237.333333, 134.444444, 286.666667, 161.111111, white, $sqx_pfd44_ink)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_triangle(237.333333, 134.444444, 230.666667, 147.777778, 237.333333, 161.111111, white, $sqx_pfd44_ink)
	; 3900 is displayed as a BIG 39 followed by a SMALL 00. No separate FL badge.
	var $sqx_pfd44_hundreds = text("{0}", floor(abs($sqx_pfd44_feet) / 100))
	if $sqx_pfd44_feet < 0
		$sqx_pfd44_hundreds = text("-{0}", floor(abs($sqx_pfd44_feet) / 100))
	var $sqx_pfd44_remainder = text("{00}", mod(round(abs($sqx_pfd44_feet)), 100))
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.text_align(top_left)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.text_size(1.7)
	var $sqx_pfd44_big_width = size($sqx_pfd44_hundreds) * $sqx_pfd44_lcd.char_w
	var $sqx_pfd44_big_height = $sqx_pfd44_lcd.char_h
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.text_size(0.9)
	var $sqx_pfd44_small_width = size($sqx_pfd44_remainder) * $sqx_pfd44_lcd.char_w
	var $sqx_pfd44_start_x = 261.444444 - ($sqx_pfd44_big_width + $sqx_pfd44_small_width) / 2
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.text_size(1.7)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.write($sqx_pfd44_start_x, 147.777778 - $sqx_pfd44_big_height / 2, white, $sqx_pfd44_hundreds)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.text_size(0.9)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.write($sqx_pfd44_start_x + $sqx_pfd44_big_width, 147.777778 - $sqx_pfd44_lcd.char_h / 2, white, $sqx_pfd44_remainder)

function @sqx_pfd44_compass($sqx_pfd44_bearing : number)
	var $sqx_pfd44_heading_base = floor($sqx_pfd44_bearing / 10) * 10
	repeat 11 ($sqx_pfd44_heading_tick)
		var $sqx_pfd44_heading_mark = $sqx_pfd44_heading_base + ($sqx_pfd44_heading_tick - 5) * 10
		var $sqx_pfd44_heading_x = 150 + ($sqx_pfd44_heading_mark - $sqx_pfd44_bearing) * 2.222222
		if ($sqx_pfd44_heading_x > 63) and ($sqx_pfd44_heading_x < 227)
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_pfd44_heading_x, 263, $sqx_pfd44_heading_x, 269, white)
			var $sqx_pfd44_heading_num = mod($sqx_pfd44_heading_mark + 720, 360)
			var $sqx_pfd44_heading_label = text("{00}", $sqx_pfd44_heading_num / 10)
			if $sqx_pfd44_heading_num == 0
				$sqx_pfd44_heading_label = "N"
			elseif $sqx_pfd44_heading_num == 90
				$sqx_pfd44_heading_label = "E"
			elseif $sqx_pfd44_heading_num == 180
				$sqx_pfd44_heading_label = "S"
			elseif $sqx_pfd44_heading_num == 270
				$sqx_pfd44_heading_label = "W"
			var $sqx_pfd44_cardinal_size = 1.1
			if mod($sqx_pfd44_heading_num, 90) == 0
				$sqx_pfd44_cardinal_size = 1.7
			@sqx_pfd44_text(0, $sqx_pfd44_heading_x, 277, $sqx_pfd44_cardinal_size, white, $sqx_pfd44_heading_label)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect(129, 284, 171, 300, cyan, $sqx_pfd44_ink)
	@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 150, 291, 1.65, cyan, text("{000}", $sqx_pfd44_bearing))
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_triangle(145, 260, 155, 260, 150, 267, yellow, yellow)

function @sqx_pfd44_marker($sqx_pfd44_mx : number, $sqx_pfd44_my : number)
	if $sqx_pfd44_path_edge
		; Off-scale trajectory: point toward it, never pretend the clamped position is precise.
		var $dx = 0
		var $dy = 0
		if mod($sqx_pfd44_path_edge, 2)
			$dx = -1
		elseif mod(floor($sqx_pfd44_path_edge / 2), 2)
			$dx = 1
		if mod(floor($sqx_pfd44_path_edge / 4), 2)
			$dy = -1
		elseif mod(floor($sqx_pfd44_path_edge / 8), 2)
			$dy = 1
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_triangle($sqx_pfd44_mx + $dx * 8, $sqx_pfd44_my + $dy * 4, $sqx_pfd44_mx - $dx * 4 + $dy * 4, $sqx_pfd44_my - $dy * 4 - $dx * 4, $sqx_pfd44_mx - $dx * 4 - $dy * 4, $sqx_pfd44_my - $dy * 4 + $dx * 4, yellow)
		return
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_circle($sqx_pfd44_mx, $sqx_pfd44_my, 4, yellow)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_pfd44_mx - 11, $sqx_pfd44_my, $sqx_pfd44_mx - 4, $sqx_pfd44_my, yellow)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_pfd44_mx + 4, $sqx_pfd44_my, $sqx_pfd44_mx + 11, $sqx_pfd44_my, yellow)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line($sqx_pfd44_mx, $sqx_pfd44_my - 10, $sqx_pfd44_mx, $sqx_pfd44_my - 4, yellow)

function @sqx_pfd44_locator($sqx_pfd44_signal : number, $sqx_pfd44_range : number, $sqx_pfd44_right : number, $sqx_pfd44_forward : number, $sqx_pfd44_up : number, $sqx_pfd44_payload : text)
	if !$sqx_pfd44_signal
		@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 150, 77.777778, 1.15, orange, "NO SIGNAL")
	else
		@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 150, 62.222222, 0.9, cyan, substring($sqx_pfd44_payload, 0, 16))
		; Display only: shared nautical-mile/feet text never feeds guidance.
		@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 150, 248.888889, 0.9, cyan, text("DIST {}", @sqx_distance31_fit($sqx_pfd44_range, 27)))
		if $sqx_pfd44_mode == 1
			; Target bearing cue in the receiver's frame; no beacon retuning.
			var $sqx_pfd44_target_x = 150 + clamp(atan($sqx_pfd44_right, $sqx_pfd44_forward) * 180 / pi, -31, 31) * 2.2
			var $sqx_pfd44_target_y = 150 - clamp(atan($sqx_pfd44_up, max(0.001, sqrt($sqx_pfd44_right * $sqx_pfd44_right + $sqx_pfd44_forward * $sqx_pfd44_forward))) * 180 / pi, -35, 35) * 2.2
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_circle($sqx_pfd44_target_x, $sqx_pfd44_target_y, 6, cyan)
		else
			; Antenna-relative docking plan view, same X-right/Y-forward mapping.
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(77.777778, 150, 222.222222, 150, cyan)
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(150, 84.444444, 150, 223.333333, cyan)
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect(138.888889, 138.888889, 161.111111, 161.111111, cyan)
			var $sqx_pfd44_dock_x = 150 + clamp($sqx_pfd44_right * $sqx_pfd44_range, -6, 6) * 10
			var $sqx_pfd44_dock_y = 150 - clamp($sqx_pfd44_forward * $sqx_pfd44_range, -6, 6) * 10
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_circle($sqx_pfd44_dock_x, $sqx_pfd44_dock_y, 5, yellow)
			var $sqx_distance31_axes = text("R {} F {}", @sqx_distance31($sqx_pfd44_right * $sqx_pfd44_range, 0), @sqx_distance31($sqx_pfd44_forward * $sqx_pfd44_range, 0))
			@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 150, 233.333333, min(0.8, 174 / max(size($sqx_distance31_axes) * 6, 1)), white, $sqx_distance31_axes)

	$sqx_pfd44_power = 0

function @sqx_pfd44_vs_tape($sqx_pfd44_fpm : number)
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect(286.666667, 0, 300, 300, $sqx_pfd44_ink, $sqx_pfd44_ink)
	@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 294.444444, 150, 0.75, white, "0")
	repeat 6 ($sqx_pfd46_vi)
		var $sqx_pfd46_distance = ($sqx_pfd46_vi + 1) * 20
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(286.666667, 150 - $sqx_pfd46_distance, 290, 150 - $sqx_pfd46_distance, gray)
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(286.666667, 150 + $sqx_pfd46_distance, 290, 150 + $sqx_pfd46_distance, gray)
		if mod($sqx_pfd46_vi, 2) == 1
			var $sqx_pfd46_vlabel = "2"
			if $sqx_pfd46_vi == 3
				$sqx_pfd46_vlabel = "6"
			elseif $sqx_pfd46_vi == 5
				$sqx_pfd46_vlabel = "12"
			@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 294.444444, 150 - $sqx_pfd46_distance, 0.75, white, $sqx_pfd46_vlabel)
			@sqx_pfd44_text(0, 294.444444, 150 + $sqx_pfd46_distance, 0.75, white, $sqx_pfd46_vlabel)
	var $sqx_pfd46_rate = clamp(abs($sqx_pfd44_fpm) / 1000, 0, 12)
	var $sqx_pfd46_offset = $sqx_pfd46_rate * 20
	if $sqx_pfd46_rate > 6
		$sqx_pfd46_offset = 80 + ($sqx_pfd46_rate - 6) * 40 / 6
	elseif $sqx_pfd46_rate > 2
		$sqx_pfd46_offset = 40 + ($sqx_pfd46_rate - 2) * 10
	var $sqx_pfd44_vpointer = 150 - sign($sqx_pfd44_fpm) * $sqx_pfd46_offset
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_line(286.666667, $sqx_pfd44_vpointer, 298.888889, $sqx_pfd44_vpointer, green)

function @sqx_pfd44_frame($sqx_pfd44_pitch : number, $sqx_pfd44_roll : number, $sqx_pfd44_speed : number, $sqx_pfd44_alt : number, $sqx_pfd44_surface : number, $sqx_pfd44_heading : number, $sqx_pfd44_fx : number, $sqx_pfd44_fy : number, $sqx_pfd44_visible : number, $sqx_pfd44_receiving : number, $sqx_pfd44_distance : number, $sqx_pfd44_bx : number, $sqx_pfd44_by : number, $sqx_pfd44_bz : number, $sqx_pfd44_data : text, $sqx_pfd44_vs : number)
	; Oversize copied square fills every corner while rolling, no circular mask.
	screen_copy($sqx_pfd44_atlas, $sqx_pfd44_lcd, 240, 240 - $sqx_pfd44_pitch * $sqx_pfd44_ppd, -150, -150, 600, 600, -1, -$sqx_pfd44_roll, 1)
	screen_copy($sqx_pfd44_bezel, $sqx_pfd44_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)
	@sqx_pfd44_speed_tape($sqx_pfd44_speed)
	@sqx_pfd44_speed_label()
	@sqx_pfd44_alt_tape($sqx_pfd44_alt, $sqx_pfd44_surface)
	@sqx_pfd44_compass($sqx_pfd44_heading)
	@sqx_pfd44_vs_tape($sqx_pfd44_vs)
	var $sqx_pfd44_tab_x = 53.333333 + $sqx_pfd44_mode * 62.888889
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect($sqx_pfd44_tab_x + 1, 1.111111, $sqx_pfd44_tab_x + 61.777778, 26.666667, cyan)
	var $sqx_pfd44_bank_angle = $sqx_pfd44_roll * pi / 180
	var $sqx_pfd44_bank_x = 150 + sin($sqx_pfd44_bank_angle) * 66
	var $sqx_pfd44_bank_y = 123.333333 - cos($sqx_pfd44_bank_angle) * 66
	$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_triangle($sqx_pfd44_bank_x, $sqx_pfd44_bank_y - 3, $sqx_pfd44_bank_x - 3, $sqx_pfd44_bank_y + 3, $sqx_pfd44_bank_x + 3, $sqx_pfd44_bank_y + 3, white, white)
	if $sqx_pfd44_mode == 0
		if $sqx_pfd44_visible
			@sqx_pfd44_marker($sqx_pfd44_fx, $sqx_pfd44_fy)
	else
		@sqx_pfd44_locator($sqx_pfd44_receiving, $sqx_pfd44_distance, $sqx_pfd44_bx, $sqx_pfd44_by, $sqx_pfd44_bz, $sqx_pfd44_data)
	@sqx_pfd46_commands($sqx_pfd44_speed, $sqx_pfd44_alt, $sqx_pfd44_heading, $sqx_pfd44_pitch, $sqx_pfd44_roll)

function @sqx_pfd48_layout()
	if !@sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
		return
	if $sqx_pfd48_position == $sqx_ui48_center
		return
	screen_copy($sqx_pfd44_lcd, $sqx_pfd48_frozen, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)
	if $sqx_ui48_center
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd = $sqx_pfd48_center
	else
		$sqx_pfd44_lcd = $sqx_pfd48_left
	$sqx_pfd48_position = $sqx_ui48_center
	screen_copy($sqx_pfd48_frozen, $sqx_pfd44_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 300)
	$sqx_pfd44_last_frame = ""

function @sqx_pfd44_update()
	@sqx_pfd48_layout()
	if !@sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
		@sqx_pfd44_poweroff()
	elseif input_number("left-anchor", 0)
		; Anchored: keep the last display. No LCD writes or drawing.
		$sqx_pfd44_ready = $sqx_pfd44_ready
	else
		if !$sqx_pfd44_ready
			@sqx_pfd44_prepare()
		; Reverse ONLY the display mappings, as verified by the user's flight test.
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_pitch = -input_number("nav", 4)
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_roll = -input_number("nav", 5)
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_air = input_number("nav", 0)
		if $sqx_pfd44_speed_source
			$sqx_pfd44_sensor_air = input_number("nav", 10)
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_alt = input_number("nav", 2)
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_clearance = max(0, min(input_number("nav", 3), $sqx_pfd44_sensor_alt))
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_vs = input_number("nav", 1)
		var $sqx_pfd44_vfpm = round($sqx_pfd44_sensor_vs * 196.8503937 / 10) * 10
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_heading = input_number("nav", 6)
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_forward = input_number("nav", 11)
		var $sqx_pfd44_sensor_right = input_number("nav", 12)
		var $sqx_pfd44_p = round($sqx_pfd44_sensor_pitch * 180 * 5) / 5
		var $sqx_pfd44_r = round($sqx_pfd44_sensor_roll * 180 * 5) / 5
		var $sqx_pfd44_k = round(abs($sqx_pfd44_sensor_air) * 1.94384449 * 2) / 2
		var $sqx_pfd44_a = round($sqx_pfd44_sensor_alt * 3.280839895)
		var $sqx_pfd44_ground_a = round(($sqx_pfd44_sensor_alt - $sqx_pfd44_sensor_clearance) * 3.280839895)
		var $sqx_pfd44_bearing = mod(round($sqx_pfd44_sensor_heading) + 360, 360)
		var $sqx_pfd44_pr = $sqx_pfd44_sensor_pitch * pi
		var $sqx_pfd44_rr = $sqx_pfd44_sensor_roll * pi
		var $sqx_pfd44_body_f = $sqx_pfd44_sensor_forward * cos($sqx_pfd44_pr) + $sqx_pfd44_sensor_vs * sin($sqx_pfd44_pr)
		var $sqx_pfd44_level_u = $sqx_pfd44_sensor_vs * cos($sqx_pfd44_pr) - $sqx_pfd44_sensor_forward * sin($sqx_pfd44_pr)
		var $sqx_pfd44_body_r = $sqx_pfd44_sensor_right * cos($sqx_pfd44_rr) + $sqx_pfd44_level_u * sin($sqx_pfd44_rr)
		var $sqx_pfd44_body_u = $sqx_pfd44_level_u * cos($sqx_pfd44_rr) - $sqx_pfd44_sensor_right * sin($sqx_pfd44_rr)
		var $sqx_pfd44_fx = 0
		var $sqx_pfd44_fy = 0
		var $sqx_pfd44_visible = 0
		$sqx_pfd44_path_edge = 0
		if $sqx_pfd44_body_f > 0.5
			$sqx_pfd44_fx = round(150 + atan($sqx_pfd44_body_r, $sqx_pfd44_body_f) * 180 / pi * $sqx_pfd44_ppd)
			$sqx_pfd44_fy = round(150 - atan($sqx_pfd44_body_u, $sqx_pfd44_body_f) * 180 / pi * $sqx_pfd44_ppd)
			; Keep the complete glyph inside the actual horizon viewport, not the old narrow gate.
			if $sqx_pfd44_fx < 66
				$sqx_pfd44_path_edge += 1
			elseif $sqx_pfd44_fx > 224
				$sqx_pfd44_path_edge += 2
			if $sqx_pfd44_fy < 40
				$sqx_pfd44_path_edge += 4
			elseif $sqx_pfd44_fy > 255
				$sqx_pfd44_path_edge += 8
			$sqx_pfd44_fx = clamp($sqx_pfd44_fx, 66, 224)
			$sqx_pfd44_fy = clamp($sqx_pfd44_fy, 40, 255)
			$sqx_pfd44_visible = 1
		if !$sqx_pfd44_visible
			$sqx_pfd44_fx = 0
			$sqx_pfd44_fy = 0
		; Read only the existing selected receiver; never select/retune a target.
		var $sqx_pfd44_receiver = "beacon"
		var $sqx_pfd44_signal = 0
		var $sqx_pfd44_range = 0
		var $sqx_pfd44_dx = 0
		var $sqx_pfd44_dy = 0
		var $sqx_pfd44_dz = 0
		var $sqx_pfd44_payload = ""
		if $sqx_pfd44_mode != 0
			if $sqx_pfd44_mode == 2
				$sqx_pfd44_receiver = "docking-beacon"
			$sqx_pfd44_signal = input_number($sqx_pfd44_receiver, 5)
			if $sqx_pfd44_signal
				$sqx_pfd44_range = round(input_number($sqx_pfd44_receiver, 1) * 10) / 10
				$sqx_pfd44_dx = round(input_number($sqx_pfd44_receiver, 2) * 1000) / 1000
				$sqx_pfd44_dy = round(input_number($sqx_pfd44_receiver, 3) * 1000) / 1000
				$sqx_pfd44_dz = round(input_number($sqx_pfd44_receiver, 4) * 1000) / 1000
				$sqx_pfd44_payload = input_text($sqx_pfd44_receiver, 0)
		var $sqx_pfd44_key = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_pfd44_p, $sqx_pfd44_r, $sqx_pfd44_k, $sqx_pfd44_a, $sqx_pfd44_ground_a, $sqx_pfd44_bearing, $sqx_pfd44_fx, $sqx_pfd44_fy, $sqx_pfd44_visible, $sqx_pfd44_mode, $sqx_pfd44_signal, $sqx_pfd44_range, $sqx_pfd44_dx, $sqx_pfd44_dy, $sqx_pfd44_dz, $sqx_pfd44_payload, $sqx_pfd44_vfpm)
		$sqx_pfd44_key = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_pfd44_key, $sqx_ui46_fd_enabled, round($sqx_ui46_fd_pitch * 5) / 5, round($sqx_ui46_fd_roll * 5) / 5, round($sqx_rx45_speed * $sqx_ui46_knots), round($sqx_rx45_alt * $sqx_ui46_feet), round($sqx_rx45_head * 2) / 2, $sqx_mynumber20, $sqx_mynumber21, $sqx_mynumber15)
		$sqx_pfd44_key = text("{},{},{}", $sqx_pfd44_key, @sqx_ui49b_ap_controlling(), $sqx_pfd44_path_edge)
		if ($sqx_pfd44_power != 1) or ($sqx_pfd44_key != $sqx_pfd44_last_frame)
			@sqx_pfd44_frame($sqx_pfd44_p, $sqx_pfd44_r, $sqx_pfd44_k, $sqx_pfd44_a, $sqx_pfd44_ground_a, $sqx_pfd44_bearing, $sqx_pfd44_fx, $sqx_pfd44_fy, $sqx_pfd44_visible, $sqx_pfd44_signal, $sqx_pfd44_range, $sqx_pfd44_dx, $sqx_pfd44_dy, $sqx_pfd44_dz, $sqx_pfd44_payload, $sqx_pfd44_vfpm)
			$sqx_pfd44_last_frame = $sqx_pfd44_key
			$sqx_pfd44_power = 1

function @sqx_pfd44_choose($sqx_pfd44_touch_x : number, $sqx_pfd44_touch_y : number)
	; VIEW selection only. Never writes AP/TAR/DOCK or beacon frequencies.
	if ($sqx_pfd44_power == 1) and ($sqx_pfd44_touch_y >= 0) and ($sqx_pfd44_touch_y < 24) and ($sqx_pfd44_touch_x >= 0) and ($sqx_pfd44_touch_x < 53.333333)
		$sqx_pfd44_speed_source = !$sqx_pfd44_speed_source
		$sqx_pfd44_last_frame = ""
		if input_number("left-anchor", 0)
			@sqx_pfd44_speed_label()
	if ($sqx_pfd44_power == 1) and ($sqx_pfd44_touch_y >= 0) and ($sqx_pfd44_touch_y < 27.777778) and ($sqx_pfd44_touch_x >= 53.333333) and ($sqx_pfd44_touch_x < 236.222222)
		$sqx_pfd44_mode = clamp(floor(($sqx_pfd44_touch_x - 53.333333) / 62.888889), 0, 2)
		$sqx_pfd44_last_frame = ""
		if input_number("left-anchor", 0)
			; Redraw only the menu header; no horizon copy or rotation.
			screen_copy($sqx_pfd44_bezel, $sqx_pfd44_lcd, 53.333333, 0, 53.333333, 0, 183, 28)
			var $sqx_pfd44_menu_x = 53.333333 + $sqx_pfd44_mode * 62.888889
			$sqx_pfd44_lcd.draw_rect($sqx_pfd44_menu_x + 1, 1.111111, min(236.222222, $sqx_pfd44_menu_x + 61.777778), 26.666667, cyan)

timer frequency 10
	@sqx_pfd44_update()

click.$sqx_pfd48_left ($sqx_pfd44_click_x : number, $sqx_pfd44_click_y : number)
	if !$sqx_ui48_center
		@sqx_pfd44_choose($sqx_pfd44_click_x, $sqx_pfd44_click_y)

click.$sqx_pfd48_center ($sqx_pfd44_click_x : number, $sqx_pfd44_click_y : number)
	if $sqx_ui48_center
		@sqx_pfd44_choose($sqx_pfd44_click_x, $sqx_pfd44_click_y)

;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;;															     ;;
;;				ALARMS DASHBOARD BY CHIP PATTON                  ;;
;;	       Please don't copy without credit.  Thanks!		     ;;			
;;															     ;;
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;

var $sqx_w49_icon = virtualscreen(24, 24)
var $sqx_w49_ready = 0
var $msg = "0"
var $dashboard = virtualscreen(250, 30)
var $txtwidth = 1
var $blankcolor = color(0,0,0,0)
var $sqx_status_last_drawn = "__INIT__"
; Session-only acknowledgements, keyed by condition rather than flashing text.
var $sqx_w49_dismissed = 0
var $sqx_w49_current_bit = 0
var $sqx_w49_raw_message : text
var $sqx_va_land_advisory : number
var $sqx_va_ascent_advisory : number
var $sqx_va_speed_advisory : number
var $sqx_ap31_advisory : number
var $sqx_ore31_advisory : number
var $sqx_ore31_notice_ink : number
var $sqx_wt39_message : text

function @sqx_w49_prepare()
	$sqx_w49_icon.blank(color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	$sqx_w49_icon.draw_triangle(12, 2, 2, 22, 22, 22, red)
	$sqx_w49_icon.text_align(top_left)
	$sqx_w49_icon.text_size(1)
	$sqx_w49_icon.write(9, 10, red, "!")
	$sqx_w49_ready = 1

function @sqx_w49_track($warning_bit : number, $warning_active : number)
	if !$warning_active
		$sqx_w49_dismissed -= $warning_bit * mod(floor($sqx_w49_dismissed / $warning_bit), 2)

function @sqx_w49_allowed($warning_bit : number, $respect_ack : number) : number
	return (!$respect_ack) or (mod(floor($sqx_w49_dismissed / $warning_bit), 2) == 0)

function @sqx_w49_pick($respect_ack : number) : text
	$sqx_w49_current_bit = 0
	$sqx_ore31_notice_ink = red
	$isalm = 1
	if ($stallt != 1) and @sqx_w49_allowed(1, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 1
		return $stallt
	elseif ($battt != 1) and @sqx_w49_allowed(2, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 2
		return $battt
	elseif ($altt != 1) and @sqx_w49_allowed(4, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 4
		return $altt
	elseif ($sqx_wt39_message != "") and ((!$sqx_wt39_warning_red) or @sqx_w49_allowed(8, $respect_ack))
		if $sqx_wt39_warning_red
			$sqx_w49_current_bit = 8
		else
			$sqx_ore31_notice_ink = orange
			$isalm = 0
		return $sqx_wt39_message
	elseif ($rott != 1) and @sqx_w49_allowed(16, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 16
		return $rott
	elseif $sqx_do32_ajar and @sqx_w49_allowed(32, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 32
		return "DOOR AJAR"
	elseif $sqx_ap31_advisory and @sqx_w49_allowed(64, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 64
		return "AP DISENGAGED"
	elseif $sqx_va_land_advisory and @sqx_w49_allowed(128, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 128
		return "LAND?"
	elseif $sqx_va_ascent_advisory and @sqx_w49_allowed(256, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 256
		if round(time / 1.5) % 2 == 0
			return "ASC LIMIT"
		return "SPEED"
	elseif $sqx_va_speed_advisory and @sqx_w49_allowed(512, $respect_ack)
		$sqx_w49_current_bit = 512
		if round(time / 0.75) % 2 == 0
			return "SPEED"
		return ""
	elseif $sqx_ore31_advisory
		$sqx_ore31_notice_ink = orange
		$isalm = 0
		return $sqx_ore31_message
	$isalm = 0
	return "0"

function @sqx_w49_acknowledge() : number
	if ($sqx_w49_current_bit <= 0) or ($sqx_status_last_drawn == "0") or ($sqx_status_last_drawn == "") or ($sqx_ore31_notice_ink != red)
		return 0
	if @sqx_w49_allowed($sqx_w49_current_bit, 1)
		$sqx_w49_dismissed += $sqx_w49_current_bit
	; Blank immediately; the normal display key will refresh on its next update.
	$dashboard.blank($blankcolor)
	$sqx_status_last_drawn = "0"
	$sqx_w49_current_bit = 0
	return 1

update
	if !$sqx_w49_ready
		@sqx_w49_prepare()
	if @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 18) == 1 && @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 19) == 1
		output_number("thrust", 0, $throt)

	$sqx_va_land_advisory = $sqx_va_land_prompt_active and ($stallt == 1) and ($battt == 1) and ($altt == 1) and ($rott == 1)
	$sqx_va_ascent_advisory = $sqx_va_ascent_governor_active and ($stallt == 1) and ($battt == 1) and ($altt == 1) and ($rott == 1)
	$sqx_va_speed_advisory = $sqx_va_speed_limited and ($stallt == 1) and ($battt == 1) and ($altt == 1) and ($rott == 1) and (!$sqx_va_ascent_advisory)
	$sqx_ap31_advisory = @sqx_ap31_pending()
	$sqx_ore31_advisory = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2) and @sqx_scan31_get(3) and (time < $sqx_ore31_until)
	$sqx_wt39_message = @sqx_wt39_warning($sqx_sw49_power)
	; Raw conditions survive the banner's flashing/off phase and priority changes.
	@sqx_w49_track(1, ($sqx_pf33_stall_since > 0))
	@sqx_w49_track(2, $btotchg < 0.25)
	@sqx_w49_track(4, (input_number("nav", 3) < 50) and ((input_number("nav", 1) < -8) or (input_number("nav", 11) > 12)))
	@sqx_w49_track(8, ($sqx_wt39_message != "") and $sqx_wt39_warning_red)
	@sqx_w49_track(16, $rott != 1)
	@sqx_w49_track(32, $sqx_do32_ajar)
	@sqx_w49_track(64, $sqx_ap31_advisory)
	@sqx_w49_track(128, $sqx_va_land_prompt_active)
	@sqx_w49_track(256, $sqx_va_ascent_governor_active)
	@sqx_w49_track(512, $sqx_va_speed_limited)
	$msg = @sqx_w49_pick(0)
	$sqx_w49_raw_message = $msg
	var $sqx_w49_raw_alarm = $isalm
	if $sqx_w49_dismissed > 0
		$msg = @sqx_w49_pick(1)
	; Acknowledgement changes presentation only, never audio/safety alarm state.
	$isalm = $sqx_w49_raw_alarm

	if ($msg == "0") or ($msg == "")
		if $sqx_status_last_drawn != "0"
			$dashboard.blank($blankcolor)
			$sqx_status_last_drawn = "0"
	else
		if $msg != $sqx_status_last_drawn
			; Opaque clear prevents the alternating advisory strings from ghosting.
			$dashboard.blank($sqx_v31_background)
			$dashboard.draw_rect(2, 1, 248, 29, $sqx_ore31_notice_ink)
			if $sqx_ore31_notice_ink == red
				screen_copy($sqx_w49_icon, $dashboard, 0, 0, 12, 3, 24, 24)
				screen_copy($sqx_w49_icon, $dashboard, 0, 0, 214, 3, 24, 24)
			$dashboard.text_align(top_left)
			$dashboard.text_size(1.75)
			var $sqx_w49_fit = min(1, 166 / max(size($msg) * $dashboard.char_w, 1))
			$dashboard.text_size(1.75 * $sqx_w49_fit)
			$txtwidth = size($msg) * $dashboard.char_w
			$dashboard.write((250 - $txtwidth) / 2, (30 - $dashboard.char_h) / 2, $sqx_ore31_notice_ink, $msg)
			$sqx_status_last_drawn = $msg

function @sqx_sw49_sync_navigation()
	; Same-frame mirror: no extra arrival-braking frame after a mode transfer.
	$pnav = $sqx_ui46_nav
	$sqx_flight_pulse48 = $sqx_ui46_nav

; Auxiliary ownership only; no gain, integral or control-output modifications.
function @sqx_sw49_unland()
	$sqx_sw49_land = 0
	$sqx_sw49_mine = 0
	$sqx_flight_pulse16 = 0
	$sqx_landing_controls_released = 0
	$sqx_landing_settled_since = 0
	; PARK deliberately remains unchanged. Anchor release works without rotors.
	$sqx_sw49_notice = "UNLAND"

function @sqx_sw49_request_land()
	if input_number("ship-dock", 0)
		$sqx_sw49_notice = "DOCKED"
		return
	$sqx_sw49_land = 1
	$sqx_sw49_park = 1
	$sqx_sw49_dock = 0
	$sqx_ui46_tar = 0
	$sqx_ui46_nav = 0
	$sqx_flight_pulse16 = 1
	if !input_number("left-anchor", 0) and $sqx_sw49_rotors
		$sqx_sw49_ap = 1
		$sqx_sw49_stab = 1
	$sqx_sw49_notice = "LANDING"

function @sqx_sw49_mine_toggle()
	if $sqx_sw49_mine
		$sqx_sw49_mine = 0
		$sqx_sw49_notice = "MINE OFF"
		return
	var $sqx_sw49_inventory = input_text("cargo-container", 0)
	if ($batts <= 0.50) or ($sqx_sw49_inventory.Rock > 8000) or (! $sqx_sw49_power)
		$sqx_sw49_notice = "MINE LIMITED"
		return
	if input_number("ship-dock", 0)
		$sqx_sw49_notice = "UNDOCK FIRST"
		return
	if (!input_number("left-anchor", 0)) and (!$sqx_sw49_rotors) and (min(input_number("nav", 2), input_number("nav", 3)) > 3)
		$sqx_sw49_notice = "ROTORS REQUIRED"
		return
	@sqx_sw49_request_land()
	$sqx_sw49_mine = 1
	$sqx_sw49_notice = "MINE / LAND FIRST"

function @sqx_sw49_powerdown()
	if $sqx_sw49_ap
		@sqx_sw49_record_ap_off("MASTER POWER OFF")
	$sqx_sw49_rotors = 0
	$sqx_sw49_stab = 0
	$sqx_sw49_ap = 0
	$sqx_sw49_mine = 0
	$sqx_ui46_tar = 0
	$sqx_ui46_nav = 0
	$sqx_sw49_was_tar = 0
	$sqx_sw49_link_until = 0
	; PARK, LAND/anchor and DOCK connection remain latched for ground safety.

function @sqx_sw49_begin()
	@sqx_sw49_boot()
	if !$sqx_sw49_power
		@sqx_sw49_powerdown()
	var $sqx_sw49_rocks = input_text("cargo-container", 0)
	if ($batts <= 0.50) or ($sqx_sw49_rocks.Rock > 8000) or (!$sqx_sw49_power)
		if $sqx_sw49_mine
			$sqx_sw49_notice = "MINE LIMITED"
		$sqx_sw49_mine = 0
	; A completed anchor landing waits until ALL three flight controls are ON.
	if $sqx_sw49_land and input_number("left-anchor", 0) and $sqx_landing_controls_released and $sqx_sw49_power and $sqx_sw49_rotors and $sqx_sw49_stab and $sqx_sw49_ap
		@sqx_sw49_unland()
	@sqx_sw49_sync_navigation()
	$sqx_flight_pulse16 = $sqx_sw49_land
	$sqx_mode = $sqx_sw49_mode
	$sqx_flight_counter7 = $sqx_sw49_mode
	$sqx_flight_counter7_init = 1

function @sqx_sw49_action($sqx_sw49_action_id : number)
	@sqx_sw49_boot()
	if $sqx_sw49_action_id == 0
		$sqx_sw49_power = !$sqx_sw49_power
		$sqx_sol_power_epoch += 1
		if !$sqx_sw49_power
			@sqx_sw49_powerdown()
	elseif !$sqx_sw49_power
		return
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 1
		if (!$sqx_sw49_rotors) and (!@sqx_wt39_can_start())
			$sqx_sw49_notice = $sqx_wt39_blocked_reason
			return
		$sqx_sw49_rotors = !$sqx_sw49_rotors
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 2
		$sqx_sw49_park = !$sqx_sw49_park
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 3
		$sqx_sw49_mode = mod($sqx_sw49_mode + 1, 3)
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 4
		if $sqx_sw49_ap
			$sqx_sw49_link_until = time + 1.5
			$sqx_sw49_notice = "AP / STAB LINKED"
		else
			$sqx_sw49_stab = !$sqx_sw49_stab
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 5
		if $sqx_sw49_ap
			@sqx_sw49_record_ap_off("AP BUTTON")
		$sqx_sw49_ap = !$sqx_sw49_ap
		if $sqx_sw49_ap
			$sqx_sw49_stab = 1
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 6
		if $sqx_sw49_ap and (!@sqx_sw49_navigation_blocked()) and (!$sqx_ad41_active)
			; One bearing capture, never continuous tracking or arrival braking.
			$sqx_ui46_nav = 0
			if input_number("beacon", 5)
				$sqx_flight_counter3 = mod(input_number("nav", 6) - input_number("nav", 25) * 180 + 720, 360)
				$sqx_mynumber15 = $sqx_flight_counter3
				$sqx_sw49_notice = "BEARING CAPTURED"
			else
				$sqx_sw49_notice = "NO TARGET SIGNAL"
		else
			$sqx_sw49_notice = "AP REQUIRED / APPROACH LOCKED"
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 7
		if $sqx_sw49_ap and (!@sqx_sw49_navigation_blocked()) and (!$sqx_ad41_active)
			$sqx_ui46_nav = !$sqx_ui46_nav
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 8
		if input_number("ship-dock", 0)
			$sqx_sw49_notice = "UNDOCK FIRST"
			return
		if $sqx_sw49_land or input_number("left-anchor", 0)
			@sqx_sw49_unland()
		else
			@sqx_sw49_request_land()
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 9
		if input_number("left-anchor", 0)
			$sqx_sw49_notice = "UNLAND FIRST"
			return
		if input_number("ship-dock", 0) and (!$sqx_sw49_rotors)
			$sqx_sw49_notice = "START ROTORS TO UNDOCK"
		else
			$sqx_sw49_dock = !$sqx_sw49_dock
			if $sqx_sw49_dock
				@sqx_sw49_unland()
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 10
		@sqx_sw49_mine_toggle()
	elseif $sqx_sw49_action_id == 11
		if (!@sqx_sw49_navigation_blocked()) and (!$sqx_ad41_active)
			$sqx_ui46_nav = 0
			; Existing 180-degree pulse path, not a new heading controller.
			$sqx_ui46_rev_until = time + 0.15
		else
			$sqx_sw49_notice = "APPROACH LOCKED"
	; Apply dependent-mode clearing in this same button callback.
	@sqx_sw49_boot()
	@sqx_sw49_sync_navigation()

function @sqx_sw49_navigation()
	@sqx_sw49_boot()
	; Reuse the NAV instrument's signed relative bearing (same sign as ND).
	; TAR takes one bearing; NAV tracks continuously and retains arrival braking.
	@sqx_sw49_sync_navigation()
	if $sqx_sw49_ap and (!$sqx_ad41_active) and $sqx_ui46_nav
		if input_number("beacon", 5) and (time >= $sqx_na_receive_after)
			if $sqx_na_arrived
				return
			$sqx_flight_counter3 = mod(input_number("nav", 6) - input_number("nav", 25) * 180 + 720, 360)
			$sqx_mynumber15 = $sqx_flight_counter3
		else
			$sqx_sw49_notice = "NO TARGET SIGNAL"
	$sqx_sw49_was_tar = $sqx_ui46_tar

; Single owner for the existing lamps. No rotor/flight outputs.
; HEAD 0/OFF 1/NORMAL 2/BRIGHT; CABIN 0/OFF 1/ON 2/AUTO.
; Shared navigation lamps: 0/OFF 1/NAV strobes 2/AREA white.
storage var $sqx_ls47_defaults : number
storage var $sqx_ls47_head : number
storage var $sqx_ls47_cabin : number
storage var $sqx_ls47_nav : number
var $sqx_ls47_lcd = screen("pilot-screen", 3)

var $sqx_ls49h_frame = virtualscreen(300, 120)

var $sqx_ls47_pressed_until = 0
var $sqx_ls47_head_start = 0

var $sqx_ls47_head_before = 0
var $sqx_ls47_head_armed = 0
var $sqx_ls47_head_long = 0

function @sqx_ls47_boot()
	if !$sqx_ls47_defaults
		$sqx_ls47_head = 0
		$sqx_ls47_cabin = 2
		$sqx_ls47_nav = 1
		$sqx_ls47_defaults = 1

function @sqx_ls47_lamp($sqx_ls47_alias : text, $sqx_ls47_on : number, $sqx_ls47_r : number, $sqx_ls47_g : number, $sqx_ls47_b : number)
	output_number($sqx_ls47_alias, 0, $sqx_ls47_on)
	output_number($sqx_ls47_alias, 1, $sqx_ls47_r)
	output_number($sqx_ls47_alias, 2, $sqx_ls47_g)
	output_number($sqx_ls47_alias, 3, $sqx_ls47_b)

function @sqx_ls47_update_lamps()
	@sqx_ls47_boot()
	var $sqx_ls47_pwr = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
	; Commit a short tap only after release, so a long hold never flashes OFF
	; on its way to BRIGHT. A completed long hold cannot toggle again on release.
	if $sqx_ls47_head_armed and ((time - $sqx_ls47_head_seen) > 0.2)
		if (!$sqx_ls47_head_long) and $sqx_ls47_pwr
			if $sqx_ls47_head_before == 0
				$sqx_ls47_head = 1
			elseif $sqx_ls47_head_before == 1
				$sqx_ls47_head = 0
			else
				$sqx_ls47_head = 1
		$sqx_ls47_head_armed = 0
	var $sqx_ls47_open = (abs(input_number("left-door-top", 0)) > 0.0001) or (abs(input_number("right-door-top", 0)) > 0.0001)
	var $sqx_ls47_cabin_on = $sqx_ls47_pwr and (($sqx_ls47_cabin == 1) or (($sqx_ls47_cabin == 2) and $sqx_ls47_open))
	var $sqx_ls48_mode = $sqx_ls47_nav
	if $sqx_ls48_mode == 3
		$sqx_ls48_mode = @sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 3)
	var $sqx_ls47_strobe = mod(time, 1) < 0.2
	var $sqx_ls47_nav_on = $sqx_ls47_pwr and (($sqx_ls48_mode == 2) or (($sqx_ls48_mode == 1) and $sqx_ls47_strobe))
	var $sqx_ls47_key = text("{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_ls47_pwr, $sqx_ls47_head, $sqx_ls47_cabin_on, $sqx_ls47_nav, $sqx_ls47_nav_on)
	if $sqx_ls47_key == $sqx_ls47_last_lamps
		return
	$sqx_ls47_last_lamps = $sqx_ls47_key
	var $sqx_ls47_brightness = 75
	if $sqx_ls47_head == 2
		; Preserve the old normal + bright amplification, not a flight setting.
		$sqx_ls47_brightness = 330
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("headlight-1", $sqx_ls47_pwr and ($sqx_ls47_head > 0), $sqx_ls47_brightness, $sqx_ls47_brightness, $sqx_ls47_brightness)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("headlight-2", $sqx_ls47_pwr and ($sqx_ls47_head > 0), $sqx_ls47_brightness, $sqx_ls47_brightness, $sqx_ls47_brightness)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("pilot-light", $sqx_ls47_cabin_on, 255, 255, 255)
	var $sqx_ls47_front_gb = 0
	var $sqx_ls47_rear_rb = 0
	if $sqx_ls48_mode == 2
		$sqx_ls47_front_gb = 255
		$sqx_ls47_rear_rb = 255
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("front-left-left-light", $sqx_ls47_nav_on, 255, $sqx_ls47_front_gb, $sqx_ls47_front_gb)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("front-left-head-light", $sqx_ls47_nav_on, 255, $sqx_ls47_front_gb, $sqx_ls47_front_gb)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("front-right-head-light", $sqx_ls47_nav_on, 255, $sqx_ls47_front_gb, $sqx_ls47_front_gb)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("front-right-right-light", $sqx_ls47_nav_on, 255, $sqx_ls47_front_gb, $sqx_ls47_front_gb)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("rear-left-rear-light", $sqx_ls47_nav_on, $sqx_ls47_rear_rb, 255, $sqx_ls47_rear_rb)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("rear-left-left-light", $sqx_ls47_nav_on, $sqx_ls47_rear_rb, 255, $sqx_ls47_rear_rb)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("rear-right-right-light", $sqx_ls47_nav_on, $sqx_ls47_rear_rb, 255, $sqx_ls47_rear_rb)
	@sqx_ls47_lamp("rear-right-rear-light", $sqx_ls47_nav_on, $sqx_ls47_rear_rb, 255, $sqx_ls47_rear_rb)

function @sqx_ls47_hit($sqx_ls47_x : number, $sqx_ls47_y : number) : number
	if ($sqx_ls47_y >= 70) and ($sqx_ls47_y < 114)
		if ($sqx_ls47_x >= 93.5) and ($sqx_ls47_x < 137.5)
			return 4
		if ($sqx_ls47_x >= 162.5) and ($sqx_ls47_x < 206.5)
			return 5
		return -1
	if ($sqx_ls47_x < 24.5) or ($sqx_ls47_x >= 275.5) or ($sqx_ls47_y < 20) or ($sqx_ls47_y >= 64)
		return -1
	if mod($sqx_ls47_x - 24.5, 69) >= 44
		return -1
	return floor(($sqx_ls47_x - 24.5) / 69)

function @sqx_ls47_button($sqx_ls47_slot : number, $sqx_ls47_label : text, $sqx_ls47_on : number, $sqx_ls47_auto : number)
	var $sqx_ls47_x = 24.5 + $sqx_ls47_slot * 69
	var $sqx_ls47_y = 20
	if $sqx_ls47_slot >= 4
		$sqx_ls47_x = 93.5 + ($sqx_ls47_slot - 4) * 69
		$sqx_ls47_y = 70
	var $sqx_ls47_border = color(120, 28, 36)
	var $sqx_ls47_fill = color(18, 24, 32)
	if $sqx_ls47_on
		$sqx_ls47_border = color(45, 215, 75)
	if $sqx_ls47_auto
		$sqx_ls47_border = color(10, 180, 205)
	var $sqx_ls48_icon = $sqx_ls47_slot
	if $sqx_ls47_slot >= 4
		$sqx_ls48_icon = 6 + $sqx_ls47_on
	if ($sqx_ls47_slot == 2) and ($sqx_ls47_nav == 2)
		$sqx_ls48_icon = 5
	if $sqx_ls47_slot == 3
		$sqx_ls47_border = color(45, 215, 75)
		if $sqx_ls48_mute
			$sqx_ls47_border = red
			$sqx_ls48_icon = 4
		if (time < $sqx_ls48_alarm_until) and (mod(time, 0.75) >= 0.375)
			$sqx_ls47_border = color(18, 24, 32)
	var $sqx_ls47_offset = 0
	if ($sqx_ls47_pressed == $sqx_ls47_slot) and (time < $sqx_ls47_pressed_until)
		$sqx_ls47_fill = color(30, 40, 52)
		$sqx_ls47_offset = 1
	$sqx_ls47_lcd.draw_rect($sqx_ls47_x + 2, $sqx_ls47_y + 2, $sqx_ls47_x + 46, $sqx_ls47_y + 46, black, black)
	$sqx_ls47_lcd.draw_rect($sqx_ls47_x, $sqx_ls47_y, $sqx_ls47_x + 44, $sqx_ls47_y + 44, $sqx_ls47_border, $sqx_ls47_fill)
	$sqx_ls47_lcd.draw_rect($sqx_ls47_x + 1, $sqx_ls47_y + 1, $sqx_ls47_x + 43, $sqx_ls47_y + 43, $sqx_ls47_border)
	$sqx_ls47_lcd.draw_line($sqx_ls47_x + 3, $sqx_ls47_y + 3, $sqx_ls47_x + 39, $sqx_ls47_y + 3, color(45, 53, 63))
	$sqx_ls47_lcd.draw_line($sqx_ls47_x + 3, $sqx_ls47_y + 3, $sqx_ls47_x + 3, $sqx_ls47_y + 40, color(45, 53, 63))
	var $sqx_ls49i_icon_nudge = 0
	if $sqx_ls47_slot == 0
		$sqx_ls49i_icon_nudge = 6
	if $sqx_ls47_slot == 2
		screen_copy($sqx_ls48_icons, $sqx_ls47_lcd, $sqx_ls48_icon * 40, 0, $sqx_ls47_x + 7 + $sqx_ls47_offset + $sqx_ls49i_icon_nudge, $sqx_ls47_y + 2 + $sqx_ls47_offset, 30, 27)
	else
		screen_copy($sqx_ls48_icons, $sqx_ls47_lcd, $sqx_ls48_icon * 40, 0, $sqx_ls47_x + 7 + $sqx_ls47_offset + $sqx_ls49i_icon_nudge, $sqx_ls47_y + 5 + $sqx_ls47_offset, 30, 27)
	@sqx_ls47_text($sqx_ls47_x + 22, $sqx_ls47_y + 37, $sqx_ls47_label, $sqx_ls47_border, 0.6)

function @sqx_ls47_poweroff()
	if $sqx_ls47_power != 0
		$sqx_ls47_lcd.blank(black)
	$sqx_ls47_power = 0
	$sqx_ls47_last_frame = ""
	$sqx_ls47_head_armed = 0

function @sqx_ls47_render()
	@sqx_ls47_boot()
	if !@sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
		@sqx_ls47_poweroff()
		return
	if !$sqx_ls48_ready
		@sqx_ls48_prepare()
	var $sqx_ls48_alarm = time < $sqx_ls48_alarm_until
	var $sqx_ls48_phase = $sqx_ls48_alarm and (mod(time, 0.75) < 0.375)
	var $sqx_ls47_key = text("{},{},{},{},{},{},{},{}", $sqx_ls47_head, $sqx_ls47_cabin, $sqx_ls47_nav, $sqx_ls47_pressed, time < $sqx_ls47_pressed_until, $sqx_ls48_mute, $sqx_ls48_alarm, $sqx_ls48_phase)
	$sqx_ls47_key = text("{},{},{}", $sqx_ls47_key, $_doors_pulse1, $_doors_pulse2)
	if ($sqx_ls47_power == 1) and ($sqx_ls47_key == $sqx_ls47_last_frame)
		return
	screen_copy($sqx_ls49h_frame, $sqx_ls47_lcd, 0, 0, 0, 0, 300, 120)
	var $sqx_ls48_label = "OFF"
	if $sqx_ls47_nav == 1
		$sqx_ls48_label = "NAV"
	elseif $sqx_ls47_nav == 2
		$sqx_ls48_label = "EXT"
	elseif $sqx_ls47_nav == 3
		$sqx_ls48_label = "AUTO"
	@sqx_ls47_button(0, "LAMP", $sqx_ls47_head > 0, $sqx_ls47_head == 2)
	@sqx_ls47_button(1, "DOME", $sqx_ls47_cabin == 1, $sqx_ls47_cabin == 2)
	@sqx_ls47_button(2, $sqx_ls48_label, ($sqx_ls47_nav > 0) and ($sqx_ls47_nav < 3), $sqx_ls47_nav == 3)
	@sqx_ls47_button(3, "SOUND", !$sqx_ls48_mute, 0)
	@sqx_ls47_button(4, "L DOOR", $_doors_pulse1, 0)
	@sqx_ls47_button(5, "R DOOR", $_doors_pulse2, 0)
	$sqx_ls47_last_frame = $sqx_ls47_key
	$sqx_ls47_power = 1

function @sqx_ls47_click($sqx_ls47_x : number, $sqx_ls47_y : number)
	if !@sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
		return
	var $sqx_ls47_slot = @sqx_ls47_hit($sqx_ls47_x, $sqx_ls47_y)
	if $sqx_ls47_slot < 0
		return
	@sqx_ls47_boot()
	$sqx_ls47_pressed = $sqx_ls47_slot
	$sqx_ls47_pressed_until = time + 0.18
	$sqx_ls47_head_armed = 0
	if $sqx_ls47_pressed == 0
		$sqx_ls47_head_before = $sqx_ls47_head
		$sqx_ls47_head_start = time
		$sqx_ls47_head_seen = time
		$sqx_ls47_head_armed = 1
		$sqx_ls47_head_long = 0
	elseif $sqx_ls47_pressed == 1
		$sqx_ls47_cabin = mod($sqx_ls47_cabin + 1, 3)
	elseif $sqx_ls47_pressed == 2
		$sqx_ls47_nav = mod($sqx_ls47_nav + 1, 4)
	elseif $sqx_ls47_pressed == 3
		$sqx_ls48_mute = !$sqx_ls48_mute
	elseif $sqx_ls47_pressed >= 4
		@sqx_do32_toggle($sqx_ls47_pressed - 4)


function @sqx_ls47_hold($sqx_ls47_x : number, $sqx_ls47_y : number)
	if !@sqx_sw49_input("main-dash", 2)
		return
	if @sqx_ls47_hit($sqx_ls47_x, $sqx_ls47_y) != 0
		$sqx_ls47_head_armed = 0
		return
	if !$sqx_ls47_head_armed
		return
	if (time - $sqx_ls47_head_seen) > 0.2
		$sqx_ls47_head_armed = 0
		return
	$sqx_ls47_head_seen = time
	$sqx_ls47_pressed = 0
	$sqx_ls47_pressed_until = time + 0.18
	if ((time - $sqx_ls47_head_start) >= 1) and (!$sqx_ls47_head_long)
		; Holding from OFF/NORMAL selects BRIGHT once; holding from BRIGHT
		; returns to NORMAL. The next short tap then turns NORMAL off.
		if $sqx_ls47_head_before == 2
			$sqx_ls47_head = 1
		else
			$sqx_ls47_head = 2
		$sqx_ls47_head_long = 1

update
	@sqx_ls47_update_lamps()

timer frequency 10
	@sqx_ls47_render()

click.$sqx_ls47_lcd ($sqx_ls47_click_x : number, $sqx_ls47_click_y : number)
	@sqx_ls47_click($sqx_ls47_click_x, $sqx_ls47_click_y)

click_hold.$sqx_ls47_lcd ($sqx_ls47_hold_x : number, $sqx_ls47_hold_y : number)
	@sqx_ls47_hold($sqx_ls47_hold_x, $sqx_ls47_hold_y)

; Shared, stateless presentation/input helpers. No flight/PID state here.
var $sqx_v31_background : number

; DISTANCE31 BEGIN helpers
; Presentation only: all sensors, scanner ranges and control math stay in metres.
; Long-form "miles" means nautical miles (1852m), never statute miles.
function @sqx_distance31($distance_m : number, $distance_long : number) : text
	var $distance_abs = abs($distance_m)
	var $distance_sign = ""
	if $distance_m < 0
		$distance_sign = "-"
	; Choose units before rounding: a distance below 1 NM always stays in feet.
	if $distance_abs >= 1852
		var $distance_miles = round($distance_abs / 1852)
		if !$distance_long
			return text("{}{0}NM", $distance_sign, $distance_miles)
		var $distance_mile_unit = "miles"
		if $distance_miles == 1
			$distance_mile_unit = "mile"
		return text("{}{0} {}", $distance_sign, $distance_miles, $distance_mile_unit)
	var $distance_feet = round($distance_abs / 0.3048)
	var $distance_ft = text("{0}", $distance_feet)
	; Retain sub-foot precision close to the dock without cluttering long ranges.
	if ($distance_abs < 30.48) and ($distance_feet != round($distance_abs / 0.3048 * 10) / 10)
		$distance_ft = text("{0.0}", $distance_abs / 0.3048)
	if $distance_abs < 0.01524
		$distance_sign = ""
	if !$distance_long
		return text("{}{}ft", $distance_sign, $distance_ft)
	var $distance_ft_unit = "feet"
	if $distance_ft == "1"
		$distance_ft_unit = "foot"
	return text("{}{} {}", $distance_sign, $distance_ft, $distance_ft_unit)

function @sqx_distance31_fit($distance_m : number, $distance_chars : number) : text
	var $distance_label = @sqx_distance31($distance_m, 1)
	if size($distance_label) > $distance_chars
		$distance_label = @sqx_distance31($distance_m, 0)
	return $distance_label
; DISTANCE31 END helpers

function @sqx_v31_ap_axis_locked($ap : number, $air : number, $ground : number) : number
	return $ap and (max(abs($air), abs($ground)) * 1.94384449 >= 15)

function @sqx_v31_speed_key($axis : number, $locked : number, $approach : number, $direction : number) : number
	return $locked and (!$approach) and ($axis * $direction > 0.5)

function @sqx_v31_center($canvas : screen, $x : number, $y : number, $scale : number, $ink : number, $label : text)
	$canvas.text_align(top_left)
	$canvas.text_size($scale)
	$canvas.write($x - size($label) * $canvas.char_w / 2, $y - $canvas.char_h / 2, $ink, $label)

; Only used while preparing cached panel frames, never in the flight loop.
function @sqx_v31_round_box($canvas : screen, $left : number, $top : number, $right : number, $bottom : number, $radius : number, $ink : number)
	$canvas.draw_line($left + $radius, $top, $right - $radius, $top, $ink)
	$canvas.draw_line($left + $radius, $bottom, $right - $radius, $bottom, $ink)
	$canvas.draw_line($left, $top + $radius, $left, $bottom - $radius, $ink)
	$canvas.draw_line($right, $top + $radius, $right, $bottom - $radius, $ink)
	repeat 4 ($corner)
		var $cx = $right - $radius
		var $cy = $bottom - $radius
		if ($corner == 1) or ($corner == 2)
			$cx = $left + $radius
		if $corner >= 2
			$cy = $top + $radius
		repeat 6 ($segment)
			var $a = ($corner * 6 + $segment) * pi / 12
			var $b = $a + pi / 12
			$canvas.draw_line($cx + cos($a) * $radius, $cy + sin($a) * $radius, $cx + cos($b) * $radius, $cy + sin($b) * $radius, $ink)

; TAKEOFF31 HELPERS BEGIN
; Transient guidance ownership only. No stored target or PID state is changed.
var $sqx_to31_active = 0
var $sqx_to31_engaging = 0
var $sqx_to31_was_ready = 0
var $sqx_to31_grounded = 0
var $sqx_to31_origin = 0
var $sqx_to31_heading = 0

function @sqx_to31_capture($to_anchor : number, $to_dock : number, $to_alt : number, $to_agl : number, $to_ground : number, $to_vs : number, $to_heading : number)
	$sqx_to31_grounded = $to_anchor or $to_dock or (($to_agl >= 0) and ($to_agl <= 3) and (abs($to_ground) < 2) and (abs($to_vs) < 0.5))
	if $sqx_to31_grounded
		$sqx_to31_origin = $to_alt
		$sqx_to31_heading = $to_heading

function @sqx_to31_update($to_ready : number, $to_approach : number, $to_anchor : number, $to_dock : number, $to_alt : number)
	var $to_was_active = $sqx_to31_active
	if (!$to_ready) or $to_approach
		$sqx_to31_active = 0
	elseif (!$sqx_to31_was_ready) and $sqx_to31_grounded
		$sqx_to31_active = 1
	$sqx_to31_was_ready = $to_ready
	; Height gained from the launch point, not terrain AGL: elevated docks work too.
	if $sqx_to31_active and (!$to_anchor) and (!$to_dock) and ($to_alt >= ($sqx_to31_origin + 15.24))
		$sqx_to31_active = 0
	$sqx_to31_engaging = $sqx_to31_active and (!$to_was_active)
; TAKEOFF31 HELPERS END

; YAWBIAS31 HELPERS BEGIN
; User-approved bounded cruise disturbance compensation, not a PID gain change.
; Session-only: never carry a learned aerodynamic bias into a fresh installation.
var $sqx_yb31_bias = 0

function @sqx_yb31_trim($yb_ready : number, $yb_approach : number, $yb_forward : number, $yb_error : number, $yb_rate : number, $yb_rate_error : number, $yb_raw : number, $yb_dt : number) : number
	if (!$yb_ready) or $yb_approach or (abs($yb_forward) < 10)
		$sqx_yb31_bias = 0
		return 0
	; Learn only near heading capture with almost no real rotation. Keep the
	; learned counter-torque through zero error instead of losing it each crossing.
	var $yb_combined = $yb_raw + $sqx_yb31_bias
	if (abs($yb_error) < 5) and (abs($yb_rate) < 0.25) and ((abs($yb_combined) < 0.95) or (($yb_combined * $yb_rate_error) < 0))
		$sqx_yb31_bias = clamp($sqx_yb31_bias + $yb_rate_error * min(max($yb_dt, 0), 0.1) * 0.006, -0.35, 0.35)
	return $sqx_yb31_bias
; YAWBIAS31 HELPERS END
